quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: Liquid Fuel
quests.subtitle: The polluter's favourite
desc:
All of these fuels are used in &6Combustion Generators&r — ranked here from the least efficient to the best.

In this pack the first combustion fuels arrive at &bMV&r: ethanol and methanol, and &2Bio Diesel&r made from seed oil, either of them and a pinch of sodium hydroxide. At &6HV&r a mixer turns diesel or bio diesel plus a little tetranitromethane into &eCetane-Boosted Diesel&r.
{@pagebreak}

&aGasoline&r comes from oil: a large chemical reactor makes raw gasoline from naphtha, refinery gas, methanol and acetone, and an &6HV&r chemical reactor finishes it with toluene. &cHigh Octane Gasoline&r, twice as strong, needs an &5EV&r large chemical reactor.

These oil fuels need a proper refinery, so distill your oils carefully: a Distillation Tower beats a row of single Distilleries.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: Let's make energy
quests.subtitle: Welcome to LV
desc:
These are your basic &61-block Generators&r. Each has a single &9input&r for its fuel — &esteam&r, &agas&r or &6liquid fuel&r — and outputs exactly &e1A&r of power at its tier.

They're simple to work with and will be your &ofirst source of power&r in &5GregTech&r until you reach the &dlarge multiblock generators&r later on.

&aEMI&r shows what each one burns, and the fuel quests nearby list the best inputs. Here's what &7LV&r offers in this pack:
{@pagebreak}

&e1. Steam Power&r:

The main road here. A Steam Turbine turns the steam from your boilers into EU: &e32 EU/t&r from &e64 mB/t&r of steam. When single boilers can't keep up, build a &6Large Bronze Boiler&r, which burns solid fuels, lava or creosote (check EMI!).
{@pagebreak}

&e2. Gas Power&r:

The Gas Turbine burns gases. At &7LV&r that means &eMethane&r: a Centrifuge gets 60 mB from every rubber log, along with sticky resin you need anyway. Not strong, but a rubber tree farm keeps it going.
{@pagebreak}

&e3. Combustion Power&r:

The Combustion Generator burns liquid fuels that pack a lot of energy per mB, easy to carry around in drums or cells. In this pack those fuels (ethanol, methanol, bio diesel, then oil products) arrive at &bMV&r, so this one can wait.

It's your choice how you want to grow your energy production.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: The MV Generators
quests.subtitle: Basically the same as the LV ones
desc:
To run your &bMV&r machines, you will need to upgrade your power production.

If an &7LV&r Generator produces &e32 EU/t&r, the &bMV&r Generator runs at &e128 EU/t&r.
It consumes four times more fuel to produce four times more energy.

At &bMV&r you also gain access to more options:

- Liquid fuels: ethanol, methanol and bio diesel, later diesel and light oil residue
- Gas fuels: methane, refinery gas, LPG and benzene
- Steam keeps working, though you may need larger pipes (steel, aluminium or potin can handle it)

The &bMV&r chapter has more on power at this tier.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: The last single block generators
quests.subtitle: Third time's the charm?
desc:
At &6HV&r the single-block generators get their last upgrade: the HV Steam Turbine, Combustion Generator and Gas Turbine.

There are no &5EV&r versions; past &6HV&r, power comes from the large turbines.

Still, they remain strong choices for energy generation at the &6HV&r tier.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: High Octane Gasoline (HOG)
quests.subtitle: Highly Powerful
desc: The direct upgrade of &cGasoline&r is a &5two times more powerful fuel&r. An &5EV&r Large Chemical Reactor mixes gasoline with octane, nitrous oxide, toluene and ethyl tert-butyl ether. By then you'll know your way around EMI's petrochemistry, so trace each ingredient there and begin the fabrication of this insanely strong fuel.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: Turbine Rotors
quests.subtitle: So many choices!
desc:
Rotor Holders naturally require a Rotor to use, but there's a lot of options and they all have different stats, so what do they all mean?

Higher &9Efficiency&r makes each mB of fuel last longer. Meanwhile, &9Power&r will increase how much EU the turbine will generate. Lastly, &9Durability&r should be obvious.
{@pagebreak}

Ideally, you'll want to maximize all three, but the choice depends on how much fuel you're producing, how many turbines you have, and how often you want to replace them, so there's no definitive correct answer.

A rotor is eight turbine blades on a long magnalium rod, put together in an &6HV&r Assembler. Hover over a rotor to compare its stats.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: Gasoline
quests.subtitle: The middle child
desc:
&aGasoline&r is a really strong combustion fuel that you can make at &6HV&r. A Large Chemical Reactor turns naphtha, refinery gas, methanol and acetone into raw gasoline, and a Chemical Reactor finishes it with &7Toluene&r, distilled from wood tar or heavy oil residue.

It's strong, and even better, it can be upgraded into &cHigh Octane Gasoline&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter gregtech_energy

quests.title: Physics Assembler
quests.subtitle: Builds that move
desc: Turns a build into a moving physics contraption: carts, boats and airships. Ground vehicles need no brass.

quests.title: Envelopes
quests.subtitle: The balloon
desc: Hot-air envelopes take wool and brass nuggets: two nuggets for four envelopes by hand, one for three with a deployer. Build them into a closed balloon.

quests.title: Hot-Air Burner
quests.subtitle: Lift
desc: Fills a balloon with hot air. It runs on redstone and burns no fuel. Brass plates, wrought iron plates and any coal or charcoal.

quests.title: Propeller Bearing
quests.subtitle: Thrust
desc: Every propeller sits on brass casing. Spin it with any Create power on board.

quests.title: Portable Engine
quests.subtitle: Power on board
desc: A fuel-burning rotation source for vehicles: an engine assembly, a brass plate and TFC fire bricks.

quests.title: Steam Lift
quests.subtitle: Optional
desc: A brass plate on a copper block. Like a Create steam engine it sits on a heated, watered fluid-tank boiler, and vents the steam into the balloon above: another way to lift.

quests.title: The Church of Diesel
quests.subtitle: Mother, how is diesel made?
desc:
&aDiesel&r is an &dOil-based &9Combustion Fuel&r.

Mix &aLight Oil Residue&r and &aHeavy Oil Residue&r at &65:1&r in an &bMV&r &3Mixer&r. From &dOil&r or &dRaw Oil&r that means several Distilleries making Light Oil Residue for every one making Heavy Oil Residue.
{@pagebreak}
You can cut the amount of &dOil&r required &6drastically&r by distilling &dHeavy Oil&r for the &aHeavy Oil Residue&r specifically: it gives far more of it.
{@pagebreak}

In general, it is better to prioritize placing down more machines (&dparallelisation&r) over overclocking the recipes. That way, you end up losing less energy processing the resources.

&aDiesel&r is burned in a &3Combustion Generator&r. It can be further refined to &6Cetane-Boosted Diesel&r in &6HV&r. Compared to the other power sources, it is generally more efficient, but a more demanding processing line. If you take the &eOil&r route for &aPolyethylene&r, this can work great with existing infrastructure. Ultimately, the power source you want to use is your choice.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: LV Superconductor
quests.subtitle: No loss no bzzz
desc:
&6Superconductors&r are special Wires available for each Voltage tier. They don't come with a Cable counterpart, but that isn't necessary, as they have absolutely &6zero cable loss&r.

They also won't damage you when you touch them. This makes them the best choice for wiring, if not a little expensive in comparison to the other wires.

The &7LV&r one is Manganese Phosphide. Manganese has no ore of its own here: electrolyzing spessartine (from red garnet) gives it, and that needs an &bMV&r Electrolyzer.

When it's time, replace your crappy &aTin Cables&r. The &3Extractor&r melts them back into tin and rubber.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o No version of GregTech has had actual Superconductors for &7LV&f up until Gregicality and GTCEu, though some modpacks had lossless cables.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter low_voltage

quests.title: Nightvision Goggles
quests.subtitle: See in the dark!
desc:
Charge them up and put them on your face to get a permanent Night Vision effect as long as the batteries last!

The glass lens they need takes an &bMV&r Lathe.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter low_voltage

quests.title: I Believe I Can Fly
quests.subtitle: ...well, almost Fly
desc:
This Jetpack burns combustion fuels to enable a primitive form of flight.

Fill it like you would fill a Drum, or with a &3Canning Machine&r. In this pack its fuels arrive at &bMV&r: ethanol, methanol or bio diesel will do.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter low_voltage

quests.title: Pyrolyse Oven
quests.subtitle: Thermal Decomposition
desc:
The &3Pyrolyse Oven&r is an electric equivalent to the &3Coke Oven&r. It turns logs into &9Charcoal&r and coal into &9Coke&r with a &9Creosote&r byproduct just as before, but with other circuits it gives other &6Organic Byproducts&r, the most useful of these being &aWood Tar&r.

It also turns &aBio Chaff&r into &aBiomass&r, which is more pertinent for your progression right now.
{@pagebreak}

The byproducts can be distilled into an array of organic resources, with &odifferent&r byproducts giving &odifferent&r ratios of &odifferent&r chemicals.

Take a peek at the &9Distillery&r Quest to get to grips with the power of distillation...
{@pagebreak}

Some recipes accept &bNitrogen&r to run faster. This isn't quite worth pursuing right now.

Its basic recipes need &d64 EU/t&r, which a single &7LV&r Energy Hatch supplies. &3Cupronickel Coils&r are fine while you get used to it, but they run it 25 percent slower than &bKanthal&r, and every coil after Kanthal makes it faster.
{@pagebreak}

&9&lNote:&r&l The plant path is one way to &9&lEthylene&r&l, which you need for your first plastic on the way to &6HV&r&l. The other path involves Oil.&r

The Pyrolyse Oven remains &doptional&r. However, it is very rewarding to build one, either for Power or for its Byproducts, and a tree farm keeps it fed.

&l&3Lore:&r&o In GT5u, the structure for the Pyrolyse Oven was infamously a giant box with only 9 coils inside. Players usually spent several minutes debugging what was wrong due to the lack of a preview.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Biomass
quests.subtitle: Plants aren't industrial enough!
desc:
Welcome to the organic &dEthylene&r path! The goal here is to produce &dEthanol&r and react it with &dSulfuric Acid&r to make &dEthylene&r.

To get &dEthanol&r, you'll need to distill it from &aBiomass&r, so let's look at the ways to produce that biomass.

The first method is simple: put &asaplings&r (TFC's count) into a &dBrewery&r with water. The downside? &eIt's slow&r.
{@pagebreak}

The second method yields much better results. Macerate &bPlant Balls&r into &aBio Chaff&r.

&bPlant Balls&r can be obtained by:
-Compressing &asaplings&r (one sapling makes one plant ball)
-Centrifuging &9rubber logs&r or &9sticky resin&r

Finally, process your &aBio Chaff&r with water in a &dBrewery&r, or go for a &dPyrolyse Oven&r for &e66 percent more&r biomass.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o You may recognise Plantballs from IndustrialCraft2! In IC2 Experimental, there was this rather... obscure way to turn Biomass into Biogas for power, which sadly required too much investment to be really worth it.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Local Brewery selling Booze
quests.subtitle: *hic*... *hic*
desc:
The Brewery can be used to make &aLubricant&r from &aRedstone&r and &aCreosote&r/&aOil&r. Lubricant has some niche uses, namely being used in the &3Cutter&r to significantly reduce the duration of its recipes.

The Brewery is a very, very slow machine, but it requires almost no power to run its recipes. Building &2many Breweries&r will help you obtain enough Biomass on your quest for plastic.

&9Note:&r The Brewery unlocks the Biomass path towards &9Ethylene&r. The same can be done in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r. The other path involves Oil.&r
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o You could make your own Brewery if you want to build up a company and start selling Booze... in GregTech 6.&r
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Ethylene
quests.subtitle: One of many hydrocarbons
desc:
Our warmest congratulations on making it here.

The way you should obtain &aEthylene&r was described in the previous Quest, depending on the route you chose.

&aEthylene&r will shortly be used in polymer production. It's also useful in a few other reactions.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Ethanol
quests.subtitle: Yo, wait - that's alcohol!
desc:
Put your previously made &aBiomass&r into a &3MV Distillery&r to make &aEthanol&r.

You will need this for &dEthylene&r by reacting it with &aSulfuric Acid&r in a &3MV Chemical Reactor&r... unless you chose to go down the Oil path.

Once you have a hefty starting stock of Ethanol, consider making and distilling &9Fermented Biomass&r in a &3Distillation Tower&r (when you get there!) for extra chemicals.

&cDo not try&r to use Ethanol as a Power source... it's quite possibly its worst use. If it's organic &9Power&r that you want, we suggest taking a look at &dBenzene&r instead!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Naphtha or Light Oil Residue
quests.subtitle: We're still confused on how Naphtha is pronounced
desc:
Distilling &aOil&r or &aRaw Oil&r gives you fuels that you need to desulfurize with &bHydrogen&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r.

The &aHydrogen Sulfide&r it leaves is perfectly &drecycled&r in an &3Electrolyzer&r, back into Hydrogen and Sulfur.

To automate this process, simply place your &3Chemical Reactor&r and your &3Electrolyzer&r next to each other. Be sure to use your &5Screwdriver&r to &4enable input from the output side&r.

&aNaphtha&r is a good &9Product&r source, and surprisingly it's also a decent fuel, but if you don't have Raw Oil then Light Oil Residue may be better. Keep following the quests for more details.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Fuel Cracking
quests.subtitle: Fuel and oil cracking can get complicated...
desc:
Don't panic! We'll mostly be doing this to get hydrocarbons.

There are many ways to acquire &dEthylene&r from Oil processing. It's easy to get lost in all the options and recipes!

The best way is to steam-crack &aNaphtha&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r. Be sure to make the &aSeverely Steam-Cracked&r version for a higher yield of Ethylene.
{@pagebreak}

Once in &6HV&r, you'll have the option to do this recipe in the &3Cracking Unit&r at 100 percent efficiency. Unfortunately, the recipes you are doing with the Chemical Reactor have a loss of &450 percent&r.

&9Note:&r All of this looks and feels terribly inefficient - we hope that's strong motivation to tier up! The &3Distillation Tower&r will be a huge upgrade for petrochem, but you're not quite there... yet. Right now, you'll have to use a &3Distillery&r to get &dEthylene&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Electricity Generation in MV
quests.subtitle: Things are 'boutta get rough
desc:
Hello there, and welcome to &bMV Energy Production&r.

In this quest, we'll go over the options for keeping your &bMV machines&r powered and running smoothly.

We won't cover this in every chapter, so we highly recommend that you &aread the GregTech Power chapter&r for a deeper understanding of how everything works.

For now, here are your options:

&7- &bUse an MV Generator&r to directly produce &bMV-level energy&r.

&7- &bStep up your &7LV&r power with transformers&r, with a &e4:1 ratio&r between &7LV&r and &bMV&r amps.
{@pagebreak}

Higher-tier Generators burn fuel faster in proportion to what they produce, so a bucket of fuel still gives the same energy. The &3Advanced Steam Turbine&r uses &d5,120 mB Steam&r per second, equivalent to &d256 mB/t&r.

Get &eany&r of these generators or transformers to complete this quest, but you may prefer starting off with the &3Advanced Steam Turbine&r.
{@pagebreak}

There are a few new power options at &bMV&r. Look up the Generators in EMI and press &4U&r to see which fuels count as &aCombustion&r or &aGas&r fuels.

The quests about fuels in this chapter cover the valuable options.

If you stick to &9Steam&r for your Power generation, you'll probably want a &3Large Boiler&r.
{@pagebreak}

&3Transformers&r step power safely up and down between voltage tiers. They turn the power they receive into the same amount of power one tier above or below.

Apart from running machines on other tiers, Transformers help carry power over long distances, as cable loss matters less at higher voltages. Just like real life!
{@pagebreak}

Transformers have 5 low voltage sides, and 1 high voltage side.

The basic Transformer converts 1A <-> 4A; the &9Hi-Amp&r Transformers move more amps at once.

A new Transformer steps down; use a &aScrewdriver&r to switch it to stepping up. From &bMV&r up, Transformers also need integrated circuit chips (ULPIC chips at &bMV&r).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Stainless Steel
quests.subtitle: HV is in your grasp
desc:
Any Steel you encounter in day-to-day life is most likely &7Stainless Steel&r. It is extremely resilient against corrosion.&r

Stainless Steel is the material for &6HV&r components, like Aluminium for &bMV&r and Steel for &7LV&r. It is also used in large amounts in the &3Distillation Tower&r.

It needs &cChromium&r, from &cRuby&r, and &2Manganese&r. In this pack manganese is scarce: it comes from &2Spessartine&r, which you get by centrifuging the &cRed Garnet&r that processing Ruby leaves behind, and then electrolyzing it in an &bMV&r Electrolyzer.
{@pagebreak}

Smelting Stainless Steel requires &dHV Power&r, which you likely do not have at this point. Scaling Power Production is crucial.

If you &9haven't already&r, it would be a good idea to get a second EBF going. Multiblocks can share blocks, so a second EBF built against the first only needs &a10 Cupronickel Coils&r instead of 16.

Have one EBF run off &bMV&r for Aluminium and any other recipes requiring &bMV&r Power, and one running off &6HV&r with &32 MV Energy Hatches&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Advanced Mixer
quests.subtitle: Mixing more complex alloys
desc:
If you're wanting to dive into &bMV&r, start here.

The dusts created in an &3MV Mixer&r have great utility.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: The MV Components
quests.subtitle: Hated crafting these in the previous tier?
desc:
Here's a list of the components you will need in &bMV&r. To ease the pain, be sure to &dbulk-craft&r these parts, especially &aMotors&r.

Familiar with the &aEmitter&r? This tier's Emitter needs a &dFlawless Emerald&r, which you'll mostly get from the &3Sifting Machine&r for now.

Conveyors, Pumps and Robot Arms are objective upgrades to &7LV&r versions if you use them as covers.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: MV Electrolyzer
quests.subtitle: We made it to MV, and, well...
desc:
&bThis one should look familiar&r: you've seen it before.
&2We highly recommend crafting it as soon as possible,&r as it opens up many new sources of &7Aluminium&r.

Until now, you were limited to electrolyzing Sapphire or ore processing byproducts to obtain &7Aluminium Dust&r.
The &bMV&r Electrolyzer runs the recipes that need more than &7LV&r power, and a whole new world of resources opens up.
{@pagebreak}

&6Here are some key materials to look for:&r
&9Ruby&r: &7Aluminium&r and &5Chromium&r.
&9Clay Dust&r (macerated clay): &7Aluminium&r, &bSilicon&r, Sodium and Lithium.
&9Emerald&r: &7Aluminium&r, &bSilicon&r and Beryllium.
&9Garnets&r (centrifuged from the Red Garnet that Ruby processing gives): &7Aluminium&r, &bSilicon&r, and &2Manganese&r from Spessartine.
&9Sodalite&r and &9Lazurite&r (from processing Lapis): &7Aluminium&r, &bSilicon&r, Sodium and &3Chlorine&r.

&2And that's just the beginning!&r Use &aEMI&r to explore even more options; we promise, there's a lot to discover.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Automatic Mining
quests.subtitle: So are you bored of mining yourself?
desc:
This kind soul will mine ores for you when placed above an ore vein, TFC's included.

Vertical range is unlimited below the miner. Horizontal range is displayed in the tooltip.

Higher tiers cover a wider area, so the &6HV&r variant reaches much more of a big vein; you may wish to hold off for now. Get &eany&r of them to complete this Quest.
{@pagebreak}

You will need &9Power&r. &aCharged Batteries&r may work, but they tend to run out of power, which is a bit inconvenient.

Our top suggestion is to use a filled &3Drum&r of some kind of fuel &7(if you're using Steam, no dice!)&r and a &3Generator&r.

Place the Drum above your Generator and right-click it with a &5Soft Mallet&r or &5Screwdriver&r to auto-output into the Generator.
{@pagebreak}

&cNote:&r Do not forget to keep the area &dchunk-loaded&r while the miner works: a chunk loader from &3Create: Power Loader&r does the job.

&9Tip:&r Use a &3GT Crate&r as the output inventory to make carrying the ores back home a simple task.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Steel Alloys
quests.subtitle: Steel Your Heart
desc:
Vanadium Steel (Vanadium, Chromium and Steel, mixed and then smelted in the EBF) is required in small quantities in progression: the &bMV&r Cutter's buzzsaw blade and the Fluid Drilling Rig's gears are made of it.

It's also &6nearly four times as durable&r as Steel when used in GregTech tools.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Advanced Cutter
quests.subtitle: Upgrades, people, upgrades!
desc:
The &3MV Cutter&r is required to cut &7Silicon Boules&r into wafers for &aLaser Engraving&r, and the engraved wafers into chips. Its saw is a &bVanadium Steel&r buzzsaw blade.

We recommend you supply this machine with a steady stream of &dLubricant&r to cut down on the processing time.

Lubricant can be &3brewed&r from &cRedstone&r and &dCreosote&r, &eSeed Oil&r or &eOil&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Laser Engraving
quests.subtitle: Teaching rocks to think
desc:
The &3Laser Engraver&r engraves patterns into &9Silicon Wafers&r based on the type of &9Lens&r it is given. After the wafers are engraved, they must be passed through a &3Cutting Machine&r to turn them into components ready to be put into Circuits.

Higher tier Engravers can etch more complex wafers for more efficient Circuits.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Upgrade your EBF!
quests.subtitle: LV is so old-school!
desc:
A &7LV&r Battery Buffer and two &7LV&r Energy Hatches likely won't cut it anymore. Let's remedy that!

Upgrade your Electric Blast Furnace with a &3MV Energy Hatch&r. Now, you can run it with &bMV&r Generators without having to mess around with &3Transformers&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Advanced Assembler
quests.subtitle: Assengers, Avemble
desc:
The &3Assembler&r is a staple for every Tier; an important goal to unlock more recipes and progress further into the Age. Many in the community see crafting a voltage tier's Assembler as a sign of &oproperly&r reaching said voltage.

That being said, welcome to &bMV&r!

The &bMV &3Assembler&r unlocks &eTransistors&r, &eCapacitors&r and &eInductors&r, used for the next tiers of Circuits.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Kanthal Coils
quests.subtitle: Is it getting hot in here?
desc:
&3Kanthal Heating Coils&r are the next major step in progression. They increase the temperature of your &3Blast Furnace&r to &d2,700K&r, allowing you to process new materials. They may also &eaccelerate&r less hot recipes; check the &aGregTech Power&r chapter for how Blast Furnace overclocks work.

Remember that you &ccannot&r mix coils in an EBF.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: First HV Circuits!
quests.subtitle: ...but hold on before getting too giddy
desc:
Alright... technically, obtaining &6HV&r Circuits and Stainless Steel lets you progress to &6HV&r - but let's not rush things.

The first thing you should make with these is a &3MV Circuit Assembler&r to unlock the new tier of Circuits right away; cheaper recipes is the &dreal payoff&r here.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Download more RAM
quests.subtitle: Also a Daft Punk album
desc: &aRandom Access Memory&r is required for many Circuits.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: More LV Circuits
quests.subtitle: You have unlocked a new tier of Circuits!
desc:
The Integrated Logic Circuit is an alternate &7LV &aCircuit&r, which is easier to mass-produce, and can be upgraded to &bMV&r (and then &6HV&r).

&9Note:&r This is not a strict upgrade to the cost of Circuits - you would need to get to the next Tier for that. It is still an important upgrade, and is required to get to &6HV circuits&r.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o The circuit progression in GTCEu is mostly based on GT5u's progression. It has been rebalanced to not be as painful. &lSpecifically&r&o this circuit tier, which was a trap!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: More MV Circuits
quests.subtitle: More... I demand more!
desc: The &bMV&r Circuit for the Integrated Tier. Don't make a ton of these, and only use them to make your first HV Circuits, because you'll soon gain access to an even better MV circuit.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Silicon Boules
quests.subtitle: Giant crystals!
desc:
&9Silicon Boules&r are grown in the &3Electric Blast Furnace&r from 32 &aSilicon Dust&r and a small pile of &aGallium Arsenide&r. Their primary purpose is to make &6Wafers&r for circuits.

After making the Boule, process it in the &3MV Cutter&r to get 16 Silicon Wafers ready for engraving.

&cWarning:&r Each Silicon Boule takes &47.5 minutes&r to make at 120 EU/t, or 1,080,000 EU! If the EBF loses power midway, the recipe will start to &close progress&r.

With that being said, Silicon Boules take an absolute age to craft, so consider &3stockpiling&r them.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Your Second Circuit Assembler
quests.subtitle: Yippee, yahoo
desc:
As is common for every tier, the &3Circuit Assembler&r is an essential part of progression, always opening up a new Tier of circuits.

At this point you should be placing a &3Drum&r next to your Circuit Assembler. Fill it absolutely full of solder fluid, and you won't have to worry about refilling for a long time.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Ultimate Smelter
quests.subtitle: Possibly the most powerful furnace you've seen
desc:
Even at its lowest power (Cupronickel coils and &7LV&r Voltage), the &dMulti Smelter&r smelts 32 items at once, far beyond any furnace you've built.

If that wasn't already enough to convince you, standard &aoverclocks&r apply with sufficient voltage.

And even better: higher tier &3Coils&r increase the number of items it can smelt in &dparallel&r!

As everywhere in this pack, iron that is smelted comes out as cast iron.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Best LV Circuits
quests.subtitle: It Feels Good to be the Best
desc:
&6The best LV Circuits&r! You can start to churn these guys out, as you'll be making them for the rest of the game.

Try to keep a stockpile of these crafted at all times - making these on-demand can take a while.

Reaching &5EV&r will unlock methods to make them even cheaper.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Best MV Circuits
quests.subtitle: MV has peaked
desc:
&6The best MV Circuits&r! You will be making these for the remainder of the game.

Eventually (in &9IV&r), they will become even cheaper.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: More HV Circuits
quests.subtitle: On that HV grind
desc:
Congrats finishing a major milestone of the &bMV Chapter&r.

Better &6HV&r Circuits - much &dcheaper&r and easier to make than before.

You should now be &aready to move on&r to the HV Chapter, unless you're yet to scale up your Power Production.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Inductors
quests.subtitle: Z = jwL
desc:
A Circuit Component that you can now make thanks to the &3MV Assembler&r and &3Polyethylene&r.

If you want the cheapest recipe, &aNickel-Zinc Ferrite&r is the way to go.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Polyethylene
quests.subtitle: Baby's first polymer!
desc:
If you want to be less fancy, just call it plastic.

For the polymerization process, add &aOxygen&r, which gives better returns than Air, then solidify like you would with Rubber.

&aPolyethylene (PE)&r is the key to unlocking &6many new things&r. It's commonly used as &dSheets&r, or in &dFluid&r form.

&l&3Lore:&r&o The OreDict and fluid name for Polyethylene in 1.12.2 GTCEu was &bplastic&f, for cross-mod compatibility.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Polyvinyl Chloride
quests.subtitle: You've already made one polymer, what's two?
desc:
&aPolyvinyl Chloride (PVC)&r is the 3rd-most produced plastic in real life. Here it can replace Polyethylene in &aPlastic Circuit Boards&r and other items to increase the yield, and from &5EV&r on its foil is one of the ways to insulate cables that rubber can't.

PVC item pipes also have the &6highest throughput&r available for a while, but most of your setups right now won't need such speed. Still, it's good to keep this knowledge in your pocket.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Plastic Boards
quests.subtitle: It's a Casio on a Plastic Board
desc:
At this point, you have all the tools you need for &9Plastic Circuit Boards&r: a Polyethylene sheet and Copper Foil, treated with &aSulfuric Acid&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r. Better plastics later (PVC, PTFE) give more boards per sheet.

Then etch more Copper Foil onto the board with &aIron III Chloride&r or &aSodium Persulfate&r for a &9Plastic Printed Circuit Board&r.

The recipe chains are starting to get pretty long, so we recommend processing large batches in two dedicated &3Chemical Reactors&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Sodium Persulfate / Iron III Chloride
quests.subtitle: Let's etch some Copper off Circuit Boards!
desc:
&aSodium Persulfate&r can be used in &9Ore Processing&r in the &3Chemical Bath&r to get various bonus outputs you would not normally obtain. It's completely optional, but pretty rewarding.

&lWait, stop! That's only a distraction&r - the real topic of this Quest is...

&aSodium Persulfate&r and &aIron III Chloride&r are used to make cheaper &9Good Circuit Boards&r, as they cut Silver usage by a factor of four. They also etch your &9Plastic Circuit Boards&r.
{@pagebreak}

Making &aSodium Persulfate&r from Salt and &aSulfuric Acid&r yields &aHydrochloric Acid&r as a coproduct, which you can react with Iron Dust to make &aIron III Chloride&r. This should be the best approach right now, but the decision is entirely yours.

Though if you are pumping &9Sea Water&r, Iron III Chloride is easy: its Chlorine and Hydrogen make plenty of Hydrochloric Acid.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Sulfuric Acid
quests.subtitle: ...what he thought was H2O was H2SO4!
desc:
EMI might look a little overwhelming here, so we'll go through the best path for Sulfuric Acid here.

Making &eSulfuric Acid&r is a three step process. It is used in many important reactions, so you should automate its production ASAP.
{@pagebreak}

To automate it, you will need &3three LV Chemical Reactors&r. We would recommend building a dedicated setup somewhere with &3a single LV Generator&r to power all three machines. You can then spaghetti your pipes to handle input and output.

&9-&r Step 1: React &aSulfur&r (crush TFC sulfur or pyrite) with &bOxygen&r to form &aSulfur Dioxide&r.
&9-&r Step 2: React &aSulfur Dioxide&r with more &bOxygen&r to form &aSulfur Trioxide&r.
&9-&r Step 3: React &aSulfur Trioxide&r with &bWater&r to form &eSulfuric Acid&r.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o GregTech 5's Chemical Reactor only had one Fluid slot. To circumvent that, they would do &dcell chemistry&f. The way you would automate Sulfuric Acid was by having one cell travel from machine to machine and then loop back to its starting position. A somewhat fun and interesting automation challenge, but also a chore!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Hydrochloric Acid
quests.subtitle: You'll need a lot of this!
desc:
Obtain &9Hydrochloric Acid&r by mixing &aHydrogen&r and &aChlorine&r.

This acid is also obtained as waste from a lot of reactions involving &aChlorine&r. Depending on your setups, you may never need to produce it directly.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: It will Melt Your Flesh
quests.subtitle: ...if you don't read this quest.
desc:
You may notice that some fluids say they are &aAcidic&r, with &9Sulfuric Acid&r being one of them.

This means that many fluid pipes will not be able to transport them safely!

At &bMV&r, the cheapest pipes for acid transportation are probably &aGold&r, with the more expensive &aStainless Steel&r pipes taking second place.

&aStainless Steel&r or &aPolytetrafluoroethylene&r (try saying that fast) will be valid options once you are in &6HV&r.
{@pagebreak}

You have three practical options for acid storage at around this point: &dGlass Vials&r, &dGold Drums&r, or &dSuper Tanks&r. Glass Vials are like &9Fluid Cells&r, and are made to store acids. Gold Drums are self-explanatory. Super Tanks can store any fluid without restriction, but are the most expensive.

&cWARNING:&r Acids in the wrong pipes will cause &cvoiding&r, &cpipe burning&r, and high chance of &cdeath&r! Be careful!

&l&3Lore:&r&o The acid transportation and storage mechanics originate from GregTech 6.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Better Batteries
quests.subtitle: Baby Got Battery
desc:
&bMV&r Batteries will appeal to you if you want to buffer Energy, just like &7LV&r.

The cost in &aSodium&r, &aLithium&r or &aCadmium&r jumps up to 8 dusts, so you should use whatever you have the most of. The difference in capacity isn't &7THAT&r huge, after all!

Get &eeither&r Battery to complete the Quest.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Advanced Extruder
quests.subtitle: The biggest upgrade you'll make
desc:
We &lSINCERELY&r hope you didn't make the &7LV&r Extruder, because only the &bMV&r Extruder is actually useful: almost every extruder recipe needs more than &7LV&r power.

The Extruder shapes solid materials into (almost!) any form using &aIngots&r. This is a great way to reduce the amount of microcrafting, as well as keeping a high conversion ratio.

The Extruder can make &6Bolts&r, &6Small Gears&r, &6Gears&r, and &6Rings&r at the highest efficiency in a single step!

You may also like to use it for &dPipes&r, &dScrews&r, and &dRotors&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Large Cells
quests.subtitle: Like cells... only larger!
desc:
Aluminium Cells are a big upgrade over the Steel Cells or Universal Fluid Cells.

They can hold any fraction of Fluid - up to &d32 buckets&r!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Fluid Drilling Rigs
quests.subtitle: Fluid Drilling Rigs in CEu!
desc:
It's quite the investment to own a &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r, but it is &oby far&r the most prominent &6source of Oil&r.

It pumps fluids from underneath Bedrock itself. Note that the fluids aren't actually there, instead being simulated.

Fluid veins are stored within &cchunk-aligned regions&r. Each vein has a different fluid, but they are mostly types of Oil.

You can't prospect for fluid veins &oyet&r: the &6HV&r prospector has a fluid mode.
{@pagebreak}

Each vein generates with a different base yield. When drained, fluid veins slowly deplete, and their yield drops until it reaches the vein's depletion yield. At that point, you should move the Rig to a different vein.

Higher tier Rigs massively increase the yield (see the multiplier in their tooltip) while depleting the vein more slowly.
{@pagebreak}

&lWhat you can find in the &2Overworld&r&l:&r

&9Oil:&r richer in &aLight Oil Residue&r, the most appreciated variant.
&9Light Oil:&r richer in &aRefinery Gas&r, usable for power.
&9Heavy Oil:&r richer in &aHeavy Oil Residue&r, which has more niche uses, notably Toluene.
&9Raw Oil:&r richer in &aNaphtha&r, the best source of the early-game oil products.
&9Natural Gas:&r grants &aRefinery Gas&r with no distillation required.
&9Salt Water:&r grants &aSodium Hydroxide&r and &aChlorine&r, useful later.

When starting out, you may have to tap randomly until you find something you like. Remember that whatever you pump could also fuel your Fluid Rig.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Distillery
quests.subtitle: The Illusion of Free Choice
desc:
Before we start, here's some important information if you're aiming to make Ethylene:

Taking the &aOil&r route will require &oat least&r a &3LV Distillery&r.

With the &aBiomass&r route, you will &lneed&r a &3MV Distillery&r.

Get &eeither&r to complete this quest.
{@pagebreak}

Got all that? &6Alright&r! Let's discuss a complex topic: &9Distillation&r. We'll try to help you understand how and why the &aEMI&r recipes are the way they are, so stick with us.

Nearly all the &3Distillery&r recipes are duplicates from the &3Distillation Tower&r, except that they only have one Fluid output, and void everything else.

In other words, you could argue the &3Distillery&r is an &dinferior&r &3Distillation Tower&r.
{@pagebreak}

This doesn't mean that the &3Distillery&r is the worse of the two. It is unlocked earlier, and it is &dsmaller&r, &dcheaper&r, and &dmore energy efficient&r per recipe.

Hell, in many cases, you won't even mind losing the other Fluids.

&3Distilleries&r are an essential component for power generation, whether you pick &aDiesel&r or &aBenzene&r.

You'll probably want many of them at as low-tier as possible to avoid the energy losses from Overclocking.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: The Church of Natural Farts
quests.subtitle: Whoever smelt it...
desc:
&aRefinery Gas&r, &aLPG&r and &aMethane&r are &9Gas Fuels&r. LPG (Liquid Petroleum Gas) is a mix of hydrocarbons typically used in heating appliances.

Refinery Gas is obtained either through &dNatural Gas&r or &dLight Oil&r, the latter yielding more, yet requiring an extra step of distillation.

Use of a &3Centrifuge&r to separate into &aLPG&r and &aMethane&r should always be done, as it's practically free.
{@pagebreak}

&a&aLPG&r and &aMethane&r are burned in a &3Gas Turbine&r. Among the other fuel options, they are the easier to set up which makes them excellent to get started. Their drawback is that they cannot be refined further, so upgrading the &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r may be a top priority if you stick to this fuel source.

&aMethane&r can also be obtained from a few &anatural sources&r. &eBetween us&r, they're memes, but you can explore them if you wish. Ultimately, your power source is your choice.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: The Church of Benzene
quests.subtitle: In the end, it &lwas&r always Benzene
desc:
&aBenzene&r is a &9Gas Fuel&r. To skip some frustration, let's check out the two best ways to obtain it.

The first option is &dWood based&r. Put Logs in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r for &9Wood Tar&r, which you &3distill&r for &aBenzene&r. The extra Charcoal can either be broken down further into &9Coal Tar&r or sent to a Boiler.

Your second option is &dHeavy Oil based&r. Put Heavy Oil in a &3Distillery&r for &9Heavy Oil Residue&r, which you &aseverely steam-crack&r and &3distill&r again for &aBenzene&r.
{@pagebreak}

For information on how to process Oil, check the Light Oil Residue and Naphtha Quests.

In general, it is better to prioritize placing down more machines (&dparallelisation&r) over overclocking the recipes. That way, you end up losing less energy processing the resources.

&aBenzene&r is burned in a &3Gas Turbine&r. Ultimately, your power source is your choice.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Light Oil Residue
quests.subtitle: Turn up the lights in here, baby
desc:
Distilling &aOil&r will give you Residue that you will need to desulfurize.

&aHydrogen Sulfide&r is perfectly &drecycled&r in an &3Electrolyzer&r.

To automate this process, simply place your &3Chemical Reactor&r and your &3Electrolyzer&r next to each other. Be sure to use your &5Screwdriver&r to &4enable input from the output side&r.

&aLight Oil Residue&r is a mediocre &9Power&r option, but you can turn it into something much greater... check the &aDiesel&r Quest.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Multiple Channel Pipes
quests.subtitle: Four fluids, one pipe
desc:
Regular &o&dGregTech&r Fluid Pipes can only transport one fluid type at a time.

&3Quadruple Fluid Pipes&r can transfer four different types of fluids. &3Nonuple Fluid Pipes&r can transfer nine different types! Useful for compact setups.

&3Nonuple Fluid Pipes&r will be useful in &5EV&r for handling the many outputs of the &3Distillation Tower&r.

Get &eeither&r to finish this quest.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: IC Chips
quests.subtitle: I C U
desc:
Using a Ruby Lens, engrave a Silicon Wafer into an ILC Wafer.

This can be processed in a Cutter for Integrated Circuit Chips, which are important components for improving upon your circuit crafting capabilities.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: ULPIC Chips
quests.subtitle: Pickin' up Chips
desc:
Using a Sapphire Lens, engrave a Silicon Wafer into an ULPIC Wafer.

This can be processed in a Cutter for ULPIC Chips, which are important for some multiblock components!

More specifically, the MV Energy Hatches that you will need to upgrade your EBF to the &6HV&r energy tier.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: I Believe I Can Fly II
quests.subtitle: ...still not quite there.
desc:
This jetpack enables flight, and requires energy.

Charge it like you would charge a Battery.

Press &4H&r (default) to enable Hover Mode.

&o&7(Yeah, yeah, a jetpack is supposed to work off propellants. Y'all are always here to nitpick.)&r
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Electronic Components
quests.subtitle: A core piece of GT progression system
desc:
Let's talk about the &dElectronic Components&r from &dGregTech&r. They are a &ccore part&r of the mod's progression and are used to make &aall circuits&r in the game.

Most components have &amultiple recipes&r. Depending on the &9materials&r you choose, you can achieve &ebetter yields&r. We encourage you to browse through &aEMI&r and decide which ones fit your situation best.

These components can be crafted in &clarge stacks&r—you'll need &ea lot&r of them for your future circuits!

For the &dTransistor&r, you’ll specifically need &5Silicon Ingots&r... but by now, you should be &cvery familiar&r with &chandling hot stuff&r, right?
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Chlorine Gas
quests.subtitle: Salty Gas
desc:
&dChlorine&r is a core component of your chemical toolkit. You’ll need &da lot of it&r for various reactions and crafting steps—the first one being &dHydrochloric Acid&r.

There are many ways to obtain &dChlorine&r, but the main source is &dsalt&r. It’s basically everywhere, so you won’t struggle to find it.

We recommend &aelectrolyzing seawater&r as an early method, but keep in mind—it’s &eslow&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Hydrogen Gas
quests.subtitle: You know about Hydrogen right?
desc:
There are &amany ways&r to get your hands on &dHydrogen&r—and it will often be a &abyproduct&r of other chemical reactions.

In &dPetrochem&r, you’ll produce a lot of &dMethane&r, which can be &aelectrolyzed&r into &dHydrogen&r. You could also electrolyze &9Water&r, but we recommend going for &9Seawater&r instead, as it gives more useful byproducts.

Later on, the &ebest method&r will be reacting &9Water&r with &dMethane&r directly—but that’s &6HV-gated&r and will start off &erather slow&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Sea Water
quests.subtitle: As wide as an ocean...
desc:
This quest is here to point out the &9Sea Water&r in &aTerraFirmaCraft&r's oceans. GregTech takes TFC's salt water wherever a recipe asks for Salt Water.

Pump it from the sea and &aelectrolyze it&r to get &dChlorine&r, &dHydrogen&r and &dSodium Hydroxide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: MV Battery Buffer
quests.subtitle: Energy management
desc: As always, we highly encourage you to use a &bBattery Buffer&r, so even if you use more &6energy&r than you produce, you won't run out of it right away, and you will be able to get the energy back while your machines aren't running.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: The HV Machine Hull
quests.subtitle: That's your fourth machine hull! This is progression
desc:
This is it—the &6HV Machine Hull&r! Congratulations on reaching this major milestone.

You had to manage &dchemicals&r, upgrade your &dEBF&r, mix a &cnew alloy&r, and learn about &aWafers&r and the &aLaser Engraver&r. We hope your &aunderstanding of GregTech&r is growing stronger every day.

From now on, &ecomplexity will increase&r at each tier, but you’ll also gain access to &anew machines&r that will ease earlier processes and introduce &9interesting new mechanics&r.

Even though you’ve just unlocked the &6HV Chapter&r, remember that this marks only &atwo&r of the &bMV Chapter&r’s main milestones.

If you haven’t unlocked the &6Second HV Circuit&r yet, we highly encourage you to do so before moving forward.

Otherwise, &aWelcome to HV!&r
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Welcome to MV!
quests.subtitle: More technology, more problems
desc:
Every time you enter a new tier, things can get a bit overwhelming. You'll be faced with lots of &enew machines&r to build and &echemicals&r to produce.

As you've probably seen in the quests, you have &2three main objectives&r to complete before progressing into &6HV&r. Let's break them down one by one.
{@pagebreak}

First, you'll need to upgrade your &dEBF&r with two new &bMV Energy Hatches&r. This will allow it to overclock and run &6HV recipes&r. That upgrade is key for producing &estainless steel&r, the main material for &6HV&r, and also &eKanthal&r, which you'll need to upgrade your &dEBF coils&r.
{@pagebreak}

Your second objective (although you can tackle it first if you prefer) involves diving into chemistry. Your first plastic, &ePolyethylene&r, is essential for future progress. There are two possible paths you can follow, and the quests will help guide you:

- &ePetrochem route&r: pump oil from deep underground with a Fluid Drilling Rig. This path also unlocks &eDiesel&r production for fuel combustion.

- &eBiochem route&r: use a &6Pyrolyse Oven&r and wood (a Create-powered tree farm works great) or a Brewery. This method gives you more &eBenzene&r and opens the door to using a &eGas Turbine&r.

Each path has its pros and cons, but eventually, you'll need both anyway.
{@pagebreak}

The final step here is unlocking the &6second HV Circuit&r. It only requires &atwo steps&r, making it faster than crafting the &6first HV Circuit&r, which needs &cthree steps&r.

To achieve this, you'll need to get your hands on a &dLaser Engraver&r, which allows you to produce your first &dWafers&r. With those, you can craft an &6HV Circuit&r that you'll use to build the &bMV Circuit Assembler&r.

It's not strictly necessary to do this now (you can continue using the first HV Circuit for progression), but &ait will make your life much easier&r if you take care of it now. Trust us.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Kanthal
quests.subtitle: This one is hot
desc:
Oh good lord, 128 ingots for 16 coils, that's a lot of &cKanthal&r... And what the heck is this &chot ingot&r thing?

Kanthal comes out of the EBF as a &cHot Ingot&r, and unlike hot metal in &aTerraFirmaCraft&r, &cit doesn't cool down on its own&r! You'll need to actively &acool it&r down.
{@pagebreak}

To do that, place hot ingots into a &dChemical Bath&r with &9Water&r, or even better, &9Distilled Water&r for a faster cooling time.

We highly recommend you &aautomate&r this process: use &apipes&r to send them directly from your &dEBF&r to your &dChemical Bath&r.

You can also set up an &aItem Tag Filter&r to help with sorting the hot ingots &7#c:hot_ingots&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Advanced Chemical Reactor
quests.subtitle: Stronger, better, faster
desc:
You already know about the &dChemical Reactor&r from the &7LV Chapter&r—but here’s a refresher.

At &bMV&r, you unlock &anew recipes&r and also gain the ability to &aoverclock your LV recipes&r. That means they can run &atwice as fast&r, but will consume &e4x the energy&r. It’s up to you to decide whether the trade-off is worth it.

But that’s not the only reason to build the &bMV Chemical Reactor&r. If you’re taking the &dorganic chemistry path&r, you’ll need it to run the &dEthylene&r recipe, which uses &dSulfuric Acid&r and &dEthanol&r—this one requires &bMV power&r.

In any case, it’s a solid machine, and not too expensive. Go ahead and build it when you have a bit of spare time.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Silicon Dust
quests.subtitle: Sillycon
desc:
Going forward, Silicon will be essential for anything involving electronics, so it's definitely something you're going to want a reliable setup for.

To obtain &5Silicon&r, we'll suggest &ctwo main methods&r so you have clear directions. As always, it's up to you to figure out what's &abest for your situation&r.
{@pagebreak}

First method: electrolyzing minerals. &aClay Dust&r (macerated clay) gives Silicon along with Aluminium, Sodium and Lithium, and so do &9Emerald&r and the &9Garnets&r from Ruby processing. Centrifuging &cRedstone&r also yields a little.

Second method: although slower early on, making Silicon out of cobblestone becomes the &ebest method&r later. Plus, it generates &9Oxygen&r as a bonus!

The idea is simple: electrolyze &aSilicon Dioxide Dust&r into Oxygen and Silicon. You get Silicon Dioxide Dust by centrifuging &9Flint Dust&r, and a &3Sifter&r turns gravel (hammered or milled from cobblestone) into plenty of Flint.

This setup can become &afully passive&r easily. Try using EMI's &aRecipe Tree&r to plan your builds; it really helps!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Get a better CPU
quests.subtitle: Gamers usually prefer GPU
desc:
The &eCPU Wafer&r is a special one—it can be upgraded later through a &2Chemical Reaction&r.

But for now, you’ll need the &eCPU Chip&r to craft the best &bMV&r circuits available at this stage.

Make sure to produce a few extra, as they’ll be essential for future upgrades.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: The Church of Bio Diesel
quests.subtitle: Flower Power
desc: Want to try something plant-based but without a tree farm? Give &3Bio Diesel&r a shot! Extract &dSeed Oil&r from seeds (look it up in EMI), then just mix it with a little Ethanol and Sodium Hydroxide (from Sea Water!) in a Chemical Reactor and you're done! As a bonus, this route also outputs Glycerol, which you can react with Carbon Dioxide into &dEthylene&r!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Silicone Rubber
quests.subtitle: Silicon, silicon, silicon everywhere!
desc:
&bSilicone Rubber&r is essentially an improved version of regular rubber. As you progress through &bGregTech&r, you will unlock better substitutes for older materials, and this is one of them.

It coats your &eWires&r for half the cost of rubber and can replace rubber in parts like Conveyors and Pumps. From &5EV&r on, most cables can't be insulated with plain rubber at all.

If you are struggling to get enough &fSticky Resin&r from rubber trees, this material will solve the issue, as it is made from &eSilicon&r, &aChlorine&r, &7Methane&r and a little Sulfur, resources you can easily produce endlessly at this stage.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Chemical Bath
quests.subtitle: Why can't we just cool these in a lake?
desc: The &dChemical Bath&r is a versatile machine, mainly used to dye materials and to get extra resources out of ores, but until you build a &bVacuum Freezer&r it is also how you cool your hot ingots. Cooling takes 120 EU/t, so you need the &bMV&r Chemical Bath.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Optical Lenses
quests.subtitle: So sparkly!
desc:
Lenses are turned on a &3Lathe&r from an &bExquisite&r gem; an &bMV&r Lathe can also turn a gem plate into one. Exquisite gems come from sifting purified gem ores, so a &aSifter&r is your friend here.

Each colour of lens engraves a different wafer: &cRuby&r for ILC, &aEmerald&r for RAM, &9Sapphire&r for ULPIC and &bDiamond&r for CPU.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Vanadium Steel Tools
quests.subtitle: A whole new set of Tools
desc:
Each new tier unlocks additional materials used to craft an entirely new set of &eTools&r.

While you may not want to replace your full set every time, it is still worth reviewing their stats, as some provide higher mining speed while others offer greater durability, and there is no absolute best choice. It ultimately depends on your priorities.

&bVanadium Steel Tools&r are a big step up in durability from Steel.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: MV Superconductors
desc: &a4A&r of &bMV&r energy transmission may be appealing, but you probably don't need these at this point. The option is always there if you need it.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter medium_voltage

quests.title: Cetane-boosted Diesel
quests.subtitle: This is to go further beyond
desc:
Now that you unlocked the &6HV&r Mixer and have access to &eNitric Acid&r, it becomes possible to make &aCetane Boosted Diesel&r, which burns three times as long as plain Diesel in a Combustion Generator.

The only tricky part is obtaining &bTetranitromethane&r. We recommend producing it by reacting &9Nitric Acid&r and &dEthenone&r. Ethenone itself isn't hard to make if you combine &9Sulfuric Acid&r - which you should have plenty of by now - and &cAcetic Acid&r, easily produced from &3Oxygen&r and &5Ethylene&r.

&cDon't forget&r to set your machine on Circuit 2, or else you'll end up producing &6Polyethylene&r instead!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Super Batteries
quests.subtitle: Science-fiction batteries!
desc: &aEnergium Crystals&r store a significant amount of &9EU&r. They're also arguably cheaper.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: HV Autoclave
quests.subtitle: Home-grown batteries
desc:
The &3HV Autoclave&r - despite being optional - is a machine you'll definitively want to grab.

This unlocks unique Batteries that are &6far superior&r to their standard counterparts.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: High Voltage Bathing
quests.subtitle: Please don't bathe with your toaster...
desc:
The &3HV Chemical Bath&r dyes Glass Lenses with &aChemical Dye&r (a dye, Sulfuric Acid and Salt reacted in a Chemical Reactor). Coloured lenses let you engrave more types of Wafers.

It also turns Ender Pearls into &5Ender Eyes&r with molten Blaze, and you'll want plenty of those for &6HV&r Emitters and Sensors.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Advanced Maintenance
quests.subtitle: I have become maintenance, eater of tape
desc:
You now have access to two &3new Maintenance Hatches&r. 

The &3Automatic Maintenance Hatch&r is pretty simple - it eliminates the need for Maintenance, &6forever&r.

The &3Configurable Maintenance Hatch&r is more interesting. You can configure it to cut off &a10%% duration&r on recipes, at the cost of making Maintenance happen three times as fast. That is &d16 real hours&r of activity. Additionally, you can use it on Multiblock Generators to increase the duration of the recipe, which indirectly increases their fuel efficiency by 10%%!

&9Reminder:&r You can put Tape in the maintenance Hatch to automatically fix problems.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o The Automatic Maintenance Hatch texture and mechanic comes from TecTech, an addon mod originally made for GregTech: New Horizons.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: High Voltage Components
quests.subtitle: We call this "fun"
desc:
Just like &bMV&r, you'll need to make higher-tier components.

The &dFlawless Emeralds&r of MV Emitters and Sensors are replaced with &dEnder Eyes&r. Also notice that the &aMotors&r require &d2x Silver Cables&r and &dElectrum&r wire, while most of the other parts, the &aHull&r and the &aMachines&r use &dGold Cables&r.

Finally, a use for that stockpile of Gold!
{@pagebreak}

&9&lTips to make life less painful:&r

- &eEnder Eyes&r: craft an Ender Pearl with &eBlaze Powder&r, which an &6HV&r Chemical Reactor makes from Carbon and Sulfur dust.
- &eElectrum&r is Gold and Silver dust in a &3Mixer&r.
- Bathe crushed Copper, Magnetite or Silver ore in &dMercury&r in the &3Chemical Bath&r for bonus &eGold&r, and crushed Gold ore for bonus &eSilver&r. Mercury comes from centrifuging Cinnabar.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: HV Assembler
desc: The &3HV Assembler&r is the next step in progression. It makes the &aSMD components&r, &aNichrome Heating Coils&r and the &6HV&r Energy Hatch, among other things - check around this quest for more.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: I see the world in colour
desc:
You'll want to grab these two lenses, dyed in the &3HV Chemical Bath&r. The &3Cyan&r lens engraves &aSimple System on Chip&r wafers, used for the best &8ULV&r Circuit recipe, while the &6Orange&r lens engraves the &aLPIC&r Wafer required for your next Energy Hatch.

Cutting LPIC wafers into chips takes an &6HV&r Cutter inside your &3Cleanroom&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Best ULV circuits!
desc: &8ULV&r Circuits stand in for Vacuum Tubes: every &7LV&r Electronic Circuit made in the Circuit Assembler takes two. One Simple SoC becomes 8 &aNAND Chips&r on a Phenolic board, or 12 on a Plastic board, which makes this the cheapest ULV circuit by far.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Upgrade your EBF II
quests.subtitle: Noticing a pattern here?
desc:
The &aLow Power Integrated Circuit&r requires an &3HV Cutter&r inside your &3Cleanroom&r.

&3HV Energy Hatches&r will be nice additions so you can run your Multiblocks (mainly your Electric Blast Furnace and Large Chemical Reactor) directly off a &6HV&r line.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: High Voltage Chemistry
desc:
The &3HV Chemical Reactor&r unlocks a ton of new recipes. Ah, who doesn't love the ever-growing demand on more advanced Chemistry?

&9Note:&r We've actually unlocked a ton of new content by reaching &6HV&r. However, not every processing line or item is crucial right now. It'd make the &6HV&r chapter far too dense if we included everything!

You could still check out the &5EV&r Chapter if you want to push yourself.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Almost Titanium
quests.subtitle: ...means it WASN'T Titanium!
desc:
Titanium requires a slightly more &binvolved&r process than the previous materials. To get started, you'll need &aRutile&r. An &3EBF&r reduces &aIlmenite&r dust with Carbon to Rutile.

Ilmenite comes from TFC &aMagnetite&r: run crushed magnetite through a &3Thermal Centrifuge&r, or centrifuge pure magnetite dust, and ilmenite is the &6Byproduct&r.

Once you've gotten enough &5Rutile&r, your journey to &6Titanium&r continues in the next quest. There's no need to rush things.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Almost Titanium²
quests.subtitle: Is it titanium yet?
desc:
To get your grubby hands on some Titanium, &aRutile&r must first be reduced to &aTitanium Tetrachloride&r with Carbon and Chlorine in an &3HV Chemical Reactor&r, then reduced again in an &3EBF&r with &dMagnesium&r to finally arrive at Titanium. The ingots come out hot, so they need the &3Vacuum Freezer&r.

The &dCarbon&r, &dChlorine&r, &dOxygen&r, and &dMagnesium&r can all be recovered: electrolyze the &dCarbon Monoxide&r back into Carbon and Oxygen, and react the &dMagnesium Chloride&r with Sodium in a Chemical Reactor for Magnesium and Salt, which electrolyzes back into Sodium and Chlorine. With that loop running, &athe only material&r that you'll need to provide for Titanium is &dRutile&r!
{@pagebreak}

&aTitanium Tetrachloride&r also acts as a catalyst in the &3Large Chemical Reactor&r's polymer recipes. A touch of &aTiCl₄&r can increase the polymer yield to &6133%%&r. Naturally, this is completely optional.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: HV Superconductors
desc:
By this point, normal Cables have such insignificant loss that superconductors aren't a requirement. That being said, they're still useful for being able to split and combine cables on the fly, and these ones are half oxygen so they're cheap too!

Superconductors are still required to craft &aField Generators&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Nichrome Coils
quests.subtitle: A long way to go before we beat the Sun
desc:
&3Nichrome Heating Coils&r bring your &3Electric Blast Furnace&r up to &d3,600K&r.

Titanium only needs Kanthal coils, but the hotter recipes ahead need these: the &6HV&r Superconductor (3,300K), Tungstensteel (3,000K) and Tungsten (3,600K).
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o In the original GregTech 5, there were only three types of coils. This was the last tier.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Titanium
desc:
&aTitanium&r has the highest corrosion resistance and strength-to-density ratio of any metallic element, so it's only natural that we'll be using it as the main material in our &5EV&r machinery.

Confirm that your closed loop for &aRutile&r is up to standard, and prepare to run a dedicated &3EBF&r for hours.

A quick aside - now that we're heading to &5EV&r, single block generators are about to fall out of style! They stop at &6HV&r, so you'll need to run several &3HV Generators&r to keep up - later, upgrades to Multiblock Generators will be required.

While Multiblock generators are much more expensive, you'll find them to be much more energy efficient! Have a look at the power chapter for more info!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Ice Cold
quests.subtitle: Did you know vacuums actually make things hotter?
desc:
The &3Vacuum Freezer&r is a multiblock used to cool down &eHot Ingots&r. All ingots made in the EBF with a temperature above &d1750K&r will need it.

Most of the time, your &3Electric Blast Furnace&r will be the bottleneck, so you don't need to worry about overclocking your freezer.

Since &eHot Ingots&r &churt you&r when held, item routing will be very useful.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: HV Circuit Assembler
quests.subtitle: You will need the Cleanroom before you can craft this one
desc:
The next &3Circuit Assembler&r. This tier is only required for one Circuit: the &aMicroprocessor Mainframe&r, your first &1IV&r Circuit, whose main use is building the &5EV Circuit Assembler&r.

You can put this off until &5EV&r or simply just use it for faster circuit making.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: The Cleanroom
quests.subtitle: They put me in a room... a clean room
desc:
The &3Cleanroom&r is a hollow multiblock free of contaminants. Going forward, most new &acircuit-related recipes&r, as well as some unique blocks like &3Fusion Casings&r, will need to be run in machines inside a Cleanroom.

Creating it will put your &aPolyethylene&r automation to the test for all the &dPlascrete&r and/or &dCleanroom Glass&r you will make.

We'll start you off with a 5x5x5 Cleanroom, but you should upgrade its size when you start feeling cramped.
{@pagebreak}

&l&3Lore:&r&o The Cleanroom comes from GregTech 5, but as is often the case, the GT5 implementation is much more punishing. The recipes would run without regard to cleanliness, but had a %% chance of completion equal to the cleanliness of the Cleanroom. This caused a lot of accidental voiding.

&oFurthermore, if the Cleanroom had a maintenance issue, the cleanliness would cap out at 90%%, which means 10%% of items would be voided.

&oThe GTCEu Cleanroom will &6never void&f recipe outputs.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: HV Prospector
desc:
This prospector boasts a &6higher range&r than its &7LV&r counterpart.

Sneak right-clicking with the Prospector in your hand will change its mode to &6Fluid Vein Mode&r. This will instead display the base &dyield&r of the bedrock Fluid veins below you, along with how full they are.
{@pagebreak}

&9Reminder:&r The yield of a &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r is directly proportional to the "fullness" of the vein. When low enough, the output will default to a yield that can be defined in the CEu config.

&9Tip:&r When the fullness drops below 30%% (alright, rough estimate), you should consider moving to another vein for the sake of power-to-yield efficiency. Aiming for the &3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig&r in &5EV&r may interest you, as not only does it significantly boost the output, but it also reduces the rate at which it drains the vein!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Fluorine
quests.subtitle: Have you brushed your teeth today?
desc:
Fluorine is the rarest gas to obtain from electrolysis in this game.

Your best source is &aTopaz&r: TFC's topaz forms in the fissures at the heart of volcanoes. The Macerator turns it into crushed Topaz ore; process that into dust and electrolyze it.

&aBiotite&r, one of the byproducts of centrifuging Stone Dust, also gives some.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Polytetrafluoroethylene
quests.subtitle: A.K.A - Teflon
desc:
&aPolytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE)&r is a &7Carbon&r-&bFluorine&r polymer. Similarly to PVC, PTFE can be used to increase the yield of Plastic Circuit Boards and other crafts. Presently, it is used to make the walls of &3Large Chemical Reactors&r.

&3Chlorine&r is required in the process, which is fully recycled if you electrolyze the &aHydrochloric Acid&r waste.

&bFluorine&r will also be used in the &aUranium&r and &7Naquadah&r refinement processes.

&9Tip:&r From this point onwards, you should be solidifying Polymers as &dBar&r (Ingot) form, as they can easily be shaped to whichever form you will need using the &3Extruder&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Large Chemical Reactor
desc:
The &3Large Chemical Reactor (LCR)&r is a multiblock &3Chemical Reactor&r with more input/output slots. Its Teflon casings allow it to process extra recipes.

The &3LCR&r can perform some exclusive reactions which allow you to combine multiple normal &3Chemical Reactor&r steps into a &6single step&r. Examples below:

&9-&r &aNitrogen Dioxide&r (for Nitric Acid and Dinitrogen Tetroxide)
&9-&r &aSulfuric Acid&r
&9-&r &aPhenol&r
&9-&r &aEpichlorohydrin&r (you need it for Epoxy!)
&9-&r &aEpoxy&r
{@pagebreak}

There are also &3LCR&r exclusive recipes. For example, &dRadon&r can only be made in the LCR right now.

All &dOverclocks&r in the &3LCR&r are &6100%% efficient&r (known as Perfect overclocks); each overclock will &5quadruple the speed&r, as opposed to doubling it.

The &3LCR&r has yet another &6advantage&r. You can use &32 Energy Hatches&r to allow it to run recipes of the &5next tier&r, similar to the &3Electric Blast Furnace&r.
{@pagebreak}

&9Tip:&r Given the amount of LCRs you may end up using, why not try utilising &dwallsharing&r to its full potential?

You could share one 2A (standard) &3Energy Hatch&r between 2 LCRs.

You might want to share &3Input/Output Hatches&r, but make sure each LCR is running the correct recipe.

Keep in mind Maintenance hatches are not sharable.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: TNT
desc: Get ready to make some explosives, as they will be required for the &cImplosion Compressor&r. Four kinds work: Powderbarrels, &cTNT&r, &dIndustrial TNT&r and Dynamite. One Industrial TNT does the work of four TNT, so we advise you to work towards it whenever you can.
{@pagebreak}

&cTNT&r (Trinitrotoluene) can't be prepared with the usual Gunpowder and Sand anymore. Instead, you'll have to produce &aGelled Toluene&r and react it with Sulfuric Acid to make TNT.

Using the &3HV Chemical Reactor&r recipe (Toluene, Sugar and Polyethylene dust) will double the yield of &aGelled Toluene&r compared to the Fluid Solidifier.
{@pagebreak}

We don't have any easy tips to give you for &aToluene&r. It's going to be tricky no matter which route you take.

That being said, don't miss out on the direct &aHeavy Fuel&r and &aWood Tar&r to &aToluene&r recipes in the single block &3Distillery&r. Wood Tar comes from logs in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r.

&aToluene&r can also optionally be used in &5EV&r to make &dGasoline&r.

&cTNT&r is used in the &3Implosion Compressor&r to make Gems. It also blows stuff up.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Ender Pearls
quests.subtitle: Sci-fi gemstones, or something
desc:
GregTech can make Ender Pearls from scratch.

Mix &2Beryllium Dust&r, &2Potassium Dust&r and &bNitrogen&r in an &6HV&r Mixer to create &5Ender Pearl Dust&r, then throw it into an &7Implosion Compressor&r to recreate the iconic Ender Pearl - GregTech style.

Beryllium comes from electrolyzing Emerald dust, Potassium from electrolyzing Rock Salt (TFC's Sylvite) or Saltpeter.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Phosphorus Boules
quests.subtitle: That's dope, bro!
desc:
Doping is the process of intentionally introducing impurities into semiconductors to alter their properties.

&7Polysilicon&r can be doped with small amounts of &ePhosphorus&r to make a better &eSilicon Boule&r.

Phosphorus-doped Silicon Boules typically yield &68 times&r more wafers than their non-doped counterparts. However, they are not strictly needed until &5EV&r, where they'll be used in more complex wafers.

&9Note&r: Cutting Phosphorus Boules and engraving their Wafers require a &dCleanroom&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Implosion Compressor
desc:
The &3Implosion Compressor&r turns the Dust form of Gems into their Gem form.

It's required to get &aEnder Pearls&r.

&cTNT&r can be used for the Implosion.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Nitric Acid
quests.subtitle: This won't eat your skin
desc:
Nitric Acid's fumes are extremely toxic! It's also a very potent oxidizer.

&aNitric Acid&r is used in:

&9-&r Cetane-Boosted Diesel, a better Diesel fuel that you'll get to soon.
&9-&r The optional gem slurry chains.
&9-&r The Platinum Group Sludge chain.
&9-&r Polybenzimidazole (try saying that ten times fast!) in &1IV&r.
{@pagebreak}

There are two main ways to make &aNitric Acid&r - &othe &agood&f way and the &4bad&f ways!&r

Therefore, we'll point you towards the best method:

Get a &3Large Chemical Reactor&r and use it to make &aNitrogen Dioxide&r. From there, react it in a regular &3Chemical Reactor&r with more &dOxygen&r and &dWater&r and you got yourself some &aNitric Acid&r!

This requires a lot of &dOxygen&r, so make sure your electrolysis keeps up. Notice that this is Hydrogen free!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: SMD Components
quests.subtitle: Alternate components!
desc:
The &eSMD&r (surface-mount device) &aComponents&r are CEu-exclusive components that are required for the next tier of circuits (&5Nano&r). They can also be used in place of their non-SMD counterparts in most Circuit recipes.

Of course they're more complicated to make, this is GregTech! What did you expect?

Invest in automation for these - you won't stop needing them.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: More SMD Components
desc:
&aSMD Diodes&r need fine &aPlatinum&r wire and Gallium Arsenide.

Platinum comes from the &dPlatinum Group Sludge&r: react purified Tetrahedrite ore with Nitric Acid in a Chemical Reactor, centrifuge the sludge with Aqua Regia, and electrolyze the raw Platinum dust.

&l&3Lore:&r&o The SMD Inductors make an appearance in GTCEu for the first time. It's more consistent and convenient to have all Circuit components receive an SMD counterpart.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Ammonia
desc:
&aAmmonia&r is &doptional&r in &6HV&r.

You may use it in the production of:
&9-&r Nitric Acid, although we don't recommend this.
&9-&r Polybenzimidazole (now THAT'S a tongue twister!) in &1IV&r.

The "least painful" recipe should be the one in the &3HV Chemical Reactor&r, from Hydrogen and Nitrogen. Make sure your &aHydrogen&r production (mostly from &aWater electrolysis&r) is enough to support the demand.

Distilling Coal Gas or Fermented Biomass also gives some &aAmmonia&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: High Voltage Mixer
quests.subtitle: Mixing never got so good
desc:
You will need the &6HV&r Mixer for several important recipes:

- &5Ender Pearl Dust&r
- &eCetane Boosted Diesel&r
- The valuable &6Ultimet Alloy&r, used for &9Turbine Rotors&r and the &5EV&r Cutter
- &9Lapotron Dust&r for &5EV&r batteries
