quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Blue Alloy
quests.subtitle: You're blue now... that's my alloy
desc:
&aBlue Alloy&r is an excellent Cable material for &6HV&r power.

Nothing is preventing you from using it for &bMV&r power too! Make sure that you don't overvolt your machines, though.

Superconductors for &6HV&r are unlocked... later.

It's one part Silver to four parts &aElectrotine&r. Electrotine has no ore here: mix &dElectrum&r and &dRedstone&r dust in a Mixer. You'll also need Blue Alloy bolts for your first &5EV&r Circuits.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: First EV Circuits!
quests.subtitle: Standing out amongst the rest
desc: Your first &5EV&r Circuit gets a unique texture. If you still consider yourself to be in &bMV&r, &ahold off&r on making too many of these, as they won't benefit you right now. We can't stop you from making these if you &djust wanna flex&r on us, though.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Welcome to HV!
quests.subtitle: Things are heating up
desc:
&2We hope you're getting the hang of &9GregTech&r, because now it's time to push your skills a bit further.
In this chapter, you'll unlock &eadvanced multiblocks&r and &ecomplex processes&r.

&6Your main goal for this chapter:&r craft your first &5EV&r Machine Hull.
{@pagebreak}

To craft the &5EV&r Machine Hull:
- Build your first &aCleanroom&r
- Construct a &bVacuum Freezer&r to cool hot ingots
- Process &9Rutile&r into &7Titanium&r

Along the way you'll make &dEnder Pearls&r from scratch, take on new &aChemistry&r with Fluorine and Nitric Acid, and upgrade your &6EBF coils&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Nichrome Ingots
quests.subtitle: It doesn't have much use
desc:
Your third coil alloy is here and it's essential for your next set of coils in the &6EBF&r.

As usual you will need &9128 ingots&r for 16 coils, but this time the ingots come out hot and, unlike Kanthal, they can't be cooled in a &6Chemical Bath&r. Instead, you're required to use a &6Vacuum Freezer&r.

Good news: it's actually simpler and faster.

The EBF recipe runs at &5EV&r voltage, so give your EBF two &6HV&r Energy Hatches.

You'll only be using &6Nichrome&r for these coils, but don't get too comfortable - it will return later for the next set of &5RTM Coils&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: &5EV&r Machine Hull
quests.subtitle: That's half of the GregTech tiers done
desc:
Well, that was quite the experience! Between the &9Rutile Processing&r line, the &5Vacuum Freezer&r, and the &5Cleanroom&r, you've uncovered a lot of new mechanics.

If your infrastructure is solid, it's time to enter &5EV&r. This complex chapter will introduce &7even more advanced systems&r and take your factory to the next level.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Ultimet
quests.subtitle: Ultimet is the ultimate
desc:
&dUltimet&r is a high-performance material, providing excellent &eSpeed&r for your &bDrill&r or &bWrench&r, and makes for a &eTurbine Rotor&r with very good &bEfficiency&r.

You'll need it even if you skip the tools: the &5EV&r Cutter, the &5EV&r Rotor Holder and the casing of &5EV&r Lapotronic Batteries are all made from it. Mix Cobalt, Chromium, Nickel and Molybdenum in the &6HV&r Mixer; the ingots come out of the EBF hot, so cool them in the &dVacuum Freezer&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: Large Steam Turbine
quests.subtitle: Expensive but so good
desc:
The &eLarge Steam Turbine&r is a very powerful &bMultiblock&r for generating power at &6HV&r. Single-block generators stop at the &6HV&r Steam Turbine, so if you plan to keep using steam power beyond that, you will need to invest in this multiblock.

It takes an &6HV&r Rotor Holder with a Turbine Rotor inside and outputs through a Dynamo Hatch. To understand how turbines work, refer to the power chapter.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter high_voltage

quests.title: This is Extreme Voltage
quests.subtitle: Tungsten, Epoxy and your first IV circuits
desc:
You've built new &6chemistry lines&r, manufactured advanced &balloys&r, and mastered the &aCleanroom&r. We hope you enjoyed the ride, because now things get even more complex, with powerful new machines and demanding processes ahead.

In the &5EV Chapter&r, your main objective will be to craft your very first &1IV&r Circuits and the &1IV&r Machine Hull.
{@pagebreak}

Along the way, several key challenges await you:

• Process &eTungsten&r and turn it into &6Tungstensteel&r, the main material of &1IV&r.

• Upgrade your EBF to &6RTM Coils&r, which open Tantalum Carbide and your first &6Alloy Blast Smelter&r.

• Set up &aEpoxy&r production for the boards of your &bNano&r Circuits.

Good luck, this is where GregTech begins to show its true depth!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Tungsten
quests.subtitle: Heavy metal
desc:
Congrats on making your first &6Tungsten&r! Electrolyze &bTungstic Acid&r in an &5EV&r Electrolyzer for Tungsten dust, plus some Hydrogen and Oxygen back.

Tungsten ingots need an &3EBF&r at 3,600K (Nichrome coils will do) and come out hot.

Remember that the further you progress, the more important it will be to build dedicated and passive lines for all these complex processes that will be required until the end of the pack. Don't be afraid of lacking resources, be afraid of lacking time.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: The Tungsten Line
quests.subtitle: Why? Just why?
desc:
&eTungsten&r comes from &aScheelite&r or &aTungstate&r dust: bathe it in Hydrochloric Acid in an &5EV Chemical Bath&r to get &bTungstic Acid&r, with Calcium Chloride or Lithium Chloride on the side.

Neither mineral has its own veins in this pack.

Take your time, optimize, and the Tungsten Line will become the foundation of your mid-to-late game progress.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: EV Assembler
quests.subtitle: Last step before some Extreme power generation!
desc:
You know what to do with this by now, but this is a good time to give you a heads up that now is the time to scale up your factory if you haven't already done so.

Automate the crafting of new machines and components to keep your factory running at tip-top shape, because if you don't, the rest of EV is going to hit you like a brick wall.

Don't wait to find out the hard way!
{@pagebreak}

At the very least, here's what we recommend before pushing further into EV:

&9-&r Passive production of Rubber, Polyethylene, Oxygen, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, and Chlorine
&9-&r At least two general-purpose EBFs, and a few LCRs
&9-&r Automated production of a circuit of every tier and most of the common crafting components like motors, pumps, plates, and wires
&9-&r A dedicated ore processing setup
&9-&r A couple EV amps worth of power generation (see the below quests)

You can do it, you've made it this far already!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: The Distillation Tower
quests.subtitle: Mr. President, another Distillation Tower has hit the factory floor
desc:
&6The Distillation Tower&r (DT) is a direct multiblock upgrade of the &6Distillery&r. You won't have to choose outputs any more as the DT will handle them all automatically, at an increased power cost.

This machine will be your future bread and butter for anything involving &ePetrochem&r or &eOrganic distillation.
{@pagebreak}

Like the &6Cleanroom&r, the DT can be made taller, though not wider. Starting from the second layer, each added level requires an &9Output Hatch&r and grants one additional fluid output slot; if a level lacks its output hatch, the corresponding fluid will be voided. Count the number of outputs with &dEMI&r so you know how many layers you need. As always, use the Multiblock Preview tab in &dEMI&r and click the multiblock to see where you can place each part.
{@pagebreak}

&cNote:&r Be careful not to over-overclock the DT when producing fuels! Excessive overclocking can reduce the overall power yield, especially for Diesel. Do the math and double-check your calculations.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Epoxy
quests.subtitle: Artificial Resin
desc:
&aEpoxy&r is the foundation for all future Circuit Boards in the game!

&9&lNote:&r This Quest is quite complicated, so tackle everything else before trying to make Epoxy. You'll need all the help you can get!
{@pagebreak}

There are several ways to obtain the ingredients for &aEpoxy&r.

We will ignore recipes related to Glycerol, as they're never worth it.

Try and use &3Large Chemical Reactors&r to shortcut recipes.
{@pagebreak}

&dChlorine&r is only partially recycled, so you'll need a constant supply. Feeding it manually will be sufficient at first.

Recipes involving &dSodium Hydroxide&r could be looped by electrolyzing the &9Salt Water&r co-product.

Doing this will probably require you to make some Quadruple Pipes, Pump Covers and Fluid Filters.

In general, closed loop setups are nice to prevent overproduction or overconsumption, but go for whatever's more fun for you.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: True Oil Distillation
desc:
The &3Distillation Tower&r splits crude oils and cracked fuels into all their fractions at once.

You will want to set this up &lbefore&r moving to &1IV&r.

Heavy Oil comes from logs in the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r, the other oils from bedrock fluid veins. Distill them into sulfuric fuels, clean those with Hydrogen, steam-crack the Light Fuel or Naphtha and distill the result again for &aBenzene&r, &aToluene&r, &aButene&r and &aButadiene&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: True Organic Distillation
desc:
This Quest requires the &3Pyrolyse Oven&r and is &doptional&r, yet convenient.

These four fluids are the important products of &aWood Tar&r Distillation:

&9-&r Phenol: useful for Epoxy and PBI
&9-&r Benzene: an important hydrocarbon
&9-&r Toluene: useful for TNT
&9-&r Dimethylbenzene: useful for PBI
{@pagebreak}

These three are the important products from &aWood Vinegar&r Distillation:

&9-&r Acetic Acid: useful to make more Acetone

&9-&r Methanol: a moderately important hydrocarbon

&9-&r Acetone: useful for Epoxy and Gasoline
{@pagebreak}

It's also possible to use a "full combo" of 4 &3DTs&r - input &aCharcoal Byproducts&r into a first tower, splitting into &aWood Tar&r, &aWood Gas&r and &aWood Vinegar&r.

This isn't the most efficient cost-to-production ratio, but the option is there if you get bored.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: We love this heater
quests.subtitle: We love this heater
desc:
The &6Alloy Blast Smelter&r is a very special multiblock. It works similarly to the &6EBF&r, with better coils allowing for Perfect Overclocking (see the power chapter), and it can process most EBF alloys straight from their element dusts &a25%% faster&r. Note that it outputs molten fluids instead of hot ingots!

One key feature of the &6ABS&r is its ability to craft the alloys needed for &6Large Multiblock Machines&r. Essentially, every basic machine like the Macerator or the Distillery has its own multiblock, offering extensive customization options such as multiple Input/Output Buses/Hatches or even adding a Parallel Hatch.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: &5EV Mixer&r
quests.subtitle: Faster than your local bartender
desc:
Some machines are critical for progression, and the &6Mixer&r is one of them.

It unlocks several essential alloys required to move forward, notably the &6RTM Alloy&r, which you’ll need to upgrade the coils of your &6EBF&r. This alloy is gated behind both the Tungsten Line and part of the Platline, so don’t expect it to be an easy one.

Soon, you’ll also unlock the &5Large Mixer&r, which allows you to install two Energy Hatches. This could be the last time you’ll need to build a single-block Mixer, though as always, the choice is yours.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: RTM Alloy
quests.subtitle: Ruthenium-Tungsten-Molybdenum Alloy
desc:
To craft &6RTM Alloy&r, you'll need &dRuthenium&r, a product of the infamous &dPlatline&r, &aTungsten&r and a little &aMolybdenum&r, mixed in your &5EV&r Mixer and smelted in the EBF at 3,000K.

Before rushing into RTM production, make sure your Platline and Tungsten line are running smoothly.

Its main use is the &6RTM Coil&r, a powerful upgrade for your EBF and many of your other coil multiblocks.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: How hot can it get?
quests.subtitle: How hot can it get?
desc:
The &6RTM Coils&r can reach an impressive &e4,500K&r, unlocking access to &dTantalum Carbide&r (4,120K), a key material for your progression: you'll need it to craft the &5Alloy Blast Smelter&r. They will also greatly speed up the recipes in your EBF.

Each coil takes RTM wire, Vanadium Steel foil and molten Nichrome, so your Nichrome production pays off again.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Large Multiblock Alloys
quests.subtitle: More alloys means more fun!
desc: Welcome to the world of &dLarge Multiblocks&r. These alloys build the casings of the large versions of GregTech's machines, starting with the &eAlloy Blast Smelter&r, which needs Tantalum Carbide plates. Tantalum Carbide needs the heat of your new RTM Coils.
{@pagebreak}

&o&6&lLore&r:&r &oGregicality Multiblocks originally began as a mod for GTCEu on Minecraft 1.12, adding the large versions of GregTech machines and the &6Parallel Hatch&r. &oWhen GTCEu was ported to 1.20, this mod was fully integrated into &dGTm&r - &osomething no one ever complained about&r. For the 1.12 enjoyers out there, you might remember them as the &dGCYM multis&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Ruthenium
quests.subtitle: A rare material
desc:
To help you along, here's an overview of the steps to &dRuthenium&r through the Platline: centrifuge &dPlatinum Group Sludge&r with Aqua Regia, react the &aInert Metal Mixture&r with Sulfuric Acid in an &5EV&r Chemical Reactor for &aRuthenium Tetroxide&r, then reduce it with Carbon.

Don't worry, you don't need to complete the entire &dPlatline&r yet.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Tungstensteel
quests.subtitle: The main material of IV
desc: You know the drill at this point. &6Tungstensteel&r will be your main material for &1IV&r, and you can expect to need a very large quantity of it: Tungsten and Steel dust in your &5EV&r Mixer, then the EBF at 3,000K. Make sure you have a dedicated &6Tungsten line&r running to sustain your production before moving further.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: That sounds like marketing
quests.subtitle: That sounds like marketing
desc:
The &dNano CPU Wafer&r is your gateway to Nano Circuits and your second kind of &1IV&r Circuit.

Coat a CPU Wafer with molten Glowstone and Raw Carbon Fibers (Carbon dust and Epoxy in an Autoclave) in an &5EV&r Chemical Reactor inside your Cleanroom, then cut it into chips in an &6HV&r Cutter.

You'll need a huge amount of these circuits, so automate the line early.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Mainframes - First IV Circuits!
quests.subtitle: Are we done with EV yet?
desc:
Finally, after all this time, you've obtained a new circuit and unlocked an entirely new tier. Mainframes are made in the &6HV&r Circuit Assembler inside your Cleanroom.

Your main focus should be the &5EV Circuit Assembler&r, which takes two of them and unlocks &bNanoprocessor Circuits&r. Keep in mind, though, that these will require Nano CPU Chips.

More details will be provided as you go, so you can finally feel fully comfortable progressing into this new tier.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: The &5EV&r Circuit Assembler
quests.subtitle: Less useful than the Assembler for now
desc: The &5EV Circuit Assembler&r won’t be of much use until you have a steady supply of &bNano CPU Wafers&r. Still, it will allow you to craft microprocessor circuits much faster and eventually give you access to your first &dLuV Circuits&r, which will be useful once you have an &1IV Assembler&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: It doesn't &olook&r that much smaller...
quests.subtitle: It doesn't &olook&r that much smaller...
desc:
Your first &eNano Circuits&r! They need &bNano CPU Chips&r and the SMD components you've been making, all in the &5EV&r Circuit Assembler inside your Cleanroom.

At first, &eNano Circuits&r will feel quite expensive, but once your Nano CPU production is fully passive, they will turn into one of your cheapest ones!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Back to the usual circuit progression
quests.subtitle: Back to the usual circuit progression
desc:
These could actually be cheaper to make than the &bMicroprocessor&r equivalent if you manage to mass-produce &bNano CPUs&r efficiently. Once that line is fully automated, these circuits will become an extremely cost-effective option for your high-end builds.

Also, note that you can use Advanced SMD components from now on!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Getting closer to LuV technology
quests.subtitle: Getting closer to LuV technology
desc:
Your second kind of &1IV&r Circuit. It needs NOR Memory Chips and SMD Diodes on top of your Nano Processor Assemblies, so it isn't actually cheaper than the &bMicroprocessor&r Mainframe.

However, it will be essential for progressing toward the next tier of technology.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Your first LuV circuits
quests.subtitle: Your first LuV circuits
desc:
Congrats on successfully reaching a new tier of circuits! These &dLuV&r Circuits won't have much use just yet, as &dLuV&r machines need materials from the full &bPlatline&r.

Most of those recipes will require an &1IV&r Assembler, so be sure you have one ready.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: NOR Memory
desc:
&aNOR Memory Chips&r go into the Nano Processor Computer, your second kind of &1IV&r Circuit.

Engrave a Phosphorus Wafer with a &dPink&r lens in an &6HV&r Laser Engraver, then cut it into chips, both inside your Cleanroom.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: IV Already?
quests.subtitle: IV Already?
desc: You've unlocked the &1IV&r Machine Hull, but it may not be very useful until you have &1IV&r Circuits. Still, you may find one or two uses for it, and at least you will be ready to build the &1IV Assembler&r as soon as you make your first &1IV&r Circuits.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Power Integrated Circuit
desc:
New Cutting Machine? &a✓&r

New Lens? &a✓&r

New Power Circuit? &a✓&r

New Coil for Energy Hatch? &a✓&r

The &aMPIC&r Wafer is a Phosphorus Wafer engraved with a &6Brown&r lens; cutting it takes an &5EV&r Cutter.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Gasoline
desc:
&aGasoline&r is an extremely powerful Combustion Fuel. It's over &63 times&r as energy dense as &dDiesel&r!

&9Note:&r This Combustion Fuel exists solely as a &echallenge&r for you to overcome if you desire to take on it.

It's completely &doptional&r, so we'll let you figure out how to obtain it, without any further tips.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Q56597d7db5891d31
desc: Another tier, another energy hatch. You know what to do with this!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: EV Dynamo Hatch
desc: If you haven't encountered them yet, Dynamo Hatches are essentially the Output equivalent of Energy Hatches. You'll want to use these on your new Large Generators for some proper EV power, covered in the next quests.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Extreme Voltage Components
quests.subtitle: The "Fun" will never stop
desc:
&7By now, you should be getting used to the pattern: with every new Energy Tier comes a fresh batch of components.&r

The &5EV&r tier comes with a few twists - first, &eNeodymium&r: the Motors need Magnetic Neodymium rods, along with &eKanthal&r wire. If you've been diligently upgrading your EBF, Kanthal should be significantly faster to craft than when you first made it, and the Alloy Blast Smelter will be able to make it even faster.

Secondly, Sensors and Emitters require &bQuantum Eyes&r - Ender Eyes bathed in Radon in the Chemical Bath - along with &ePlatinum&r rods.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: A new board, there is more to come
quests.subtitle: A new board, there is more to come
desc: Epoxy Circuit Boards are a key component required to craft your &bNano Circuits&r, but they won’t have much use outside of that purpose.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: You Crack Me Up
quests.subtitle: You Crack Me Up
desc:
The &3Cracker&r is a multiblock built with the sole purpose of cracking fluids. It comes with all the recipes of &3Chemical Reactor&r Cracking, but it is &6lossless&r.

This is a great way to save a lot of Fuel in the long term!

Higher Coil tiers provide a small energy discount - up to 70%% with the best Coils available.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Liquid Air
quests.subtitle: So many gases
desc:
Distilling &bLiquid Air&r is a core mechanic in &6GregTech&r to obtain an &oinfinite supply&r of certain rare gases.

Liquefy Air in your &3Vacuum Freezer&r, then distill it to get your hands on &bArgon&r, &6Oxygen&r, &eHelium&r, &3Nitrogen&r and &aCarbon Dioxide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Epichlorohydrin
desc:
You're going to want to use the &3LCR&r recipe for your first &aEpichlorohydrin&r.

This recipe requires &aPropene&r, which means that &dOil Processing&r and &dFuel Cracking&r are now necessary ventures. We're truly sorry if you've been dragging your heels!

It's quite important that you make your first &3Distillation Tower&r before progressing to the right.

Last of all, if you haven't noticed, you can loop the &dSalt Water&r byproduct to bootstrap the &dSodium Hydroxide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Phenol
desc:
Obtain &aPhenol&r from:

&91 -&r &aWood Tar&r distillation.

&92 -&r Reacting &aBenzene&r with &dChlorine&r and &dSodium Hydroxide&r This should be performed in an &3LCR&r, and the Chlorine is perfectly looped.

&93 -&r Shortcutting the above recipe by ignoring the &dSodium Hydroxide&r. This is net negative on &dChlorine&r.

&94 -&r Reacting &aBenzene&r, &dPropene&r and &dOxygen&r using a small amount of &4Phosphoric Acid&r - normally a catalyst, but consumed here in small quantities. This is called the Cumene process.
{@pagebreak}

If you're having trouble deciding between the options presented, here's the appeal of each route:

&91 -&r Great if you're willing to set up a &3Pyrolyse Oven&r + &3Distillation Tower&r combo.

&92 -&r This one's our preference! You can use the &dSalt&r to make more &dSalt Water&r, then electrolyze to create a loop.

&93 -&r Very appealing if you have an infinite supply of &dChlorine&r. You could achieve this by setting up a &3Fluid Drilling Rig&r on a Salt Water vein.

&94 -&r ...&4Phosphoric Acid&r is a pain to produce. You'd be mad to consider this.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Acetone
desc:
While distilling &aWood Vinegar&r gives &aAcetone&r, the yield is low and might not meet your needs.

You might want to use the direct &3LCR&r recipe from &aAcetic Acid&r to obtain &aAcetone&r.

If you want to be fancy, you can also the good old &aAcetic Acid&r -> &dDissolved Calcium Acetate&r -> &aAcetone&r loop, which does not require a &3LCR&r, but still recycles the Calcium compound perfectly.
{@pagebreak}

We've been talking about Acetic Acid, but we're yet to tell you how to obtain it. Wouldn't that be great?

&aAcetic Acid&r can be synthesized in the &3Chemical Reactor&r. Our favorite recipe is from &dEthylene&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Extreme Fluid Drilling
quests.subtitle: Extreme is an apt descriptor
desc:
At the cost of 4x the drilling Power, the &3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig&r gains &616x the output&r in Fluid.

The depletion of veins is also halved. This means you will get a total of &632x&r as much Oil (or whatever fluid) from a bedrock fluid vein until depletion!

Even when depleted, you can still use this and be firmly power positive.

One single &3Advanced Fluid Drilling Rig&r should be enough to supply Power for a base up to &dLuV&r... and possibly beyond!
{@pagebreak}

As a &9reminder&r, since this last appeared in &bMV&r:

&9-&r &aLight Oil&r can be used for &dLPG&r and &dMethane&r to run in &3Large Gas Turbines&r.

&9-&r &aOil&r can be used for &dDiesel&r and &dCetane-Boosted Diesel&r to run in &3Large Combustion Engines&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Extreme Power Generation
desc: The various single-block generators only go up to HV, so from here on, you'll have to use multiblocks to generate more power. Two of the best options at EV are the &dLarge Gas Turbine&r and &dLarge Combustion Engine&r, so head over to the power chapter to learn more about them.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Tungsten Carbide Tools
quests.subtitle: As fast as you can expect
desc: &bTungsten Carbide Tools&r clearly belong to the extreme &eSpeed&r category, but they come with relatively low &aDurability&r and the fact that &6Tungsten&r may still be somewhat tedious to produce at this stage. They may even be too fast to comfortably use as a &bWrench&r, but they can feel excellent when crafted as a &bDrill&r or &bWire Cutter&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter extreme_voltage

quests.title: Down to the Floor
quests.subtitle: The ocean is open at copper
desc: The sea floor holds ores that no land vein has. Copper diving gear is enough to reach all of it: there is no pressure or depth limit, only air. A full backtank is fifteen minutes; place it, give it rotation and it fills again.
Deep ocean floors lie at about y -17 and the trenches at -48, and lava starts at -54: red steel diving gear does not make lava safe (see the Tips). Mining under water is slow without Aqua Affinity.

quests.title: Manganese Nodules
quests.subtitle: Broad and thin
desc: On the deep ocean floor, nodules lie loose on the mud in broad fields around small cores of nodule bed. Pick a loose one up by hand, or sweep the bed blocks with a shovel: each gives raw pyrolusite (manganese), now and then cobaltite.

Macerate it for crushed pyrolusite, wash it, spin it in a thermal centrifuge and macerate the refined ore: the dust comes with a little niobium. Manganese arrives with the macerator too (step 19), so stainless steel does not wait for anything else.

quests.title: Manganese Crust
quests.subtitle: Rock with a skin
desc: Bare ridge and arc rock is coated in ferromanganese crust. A pickaxe gives raw pyrolusite, cobaltite and, rarely (one block in 25), pitchblende: the pack's stand-in for the uranium that crusts really do adsorb.

Pitchblende goes the usual way (crush, wash, thermal centrifuge) to uraninite, then hydrofluoric acid and fluorine make uranium hexafluoride, and an electrolyzer separates uranium 235 and 238. The fluorine is the slow part: biotite is the pack's source.

quests.title: A Vent Field
quests.subtitle: Black smokers on the ridge
desc: Along the mid-ocean ridge's axis, a field of sulfide chimneys stands on a mound about every thirty kilometres. They glow faintly and puff dark water from the tip. A pickaxe gives raw chalcopyrite, pyrite, sphalerite and galena.
Arc vents are white smokers: anhydrite, some zinc sulfide and, once in a while, pollucite (caesium).
The ridge is far from the coast: ocean floor 3,000 blocks across, with the axis a thin band in the middle. Magma rock and rising bubbles mark it.

quests.title: Niobium
quests.subtitle: Superconductors start here
desc: Niobium dust is a by-product of refined pyrolusite when it is macerated (14%). It makes niobium nitride (HV chemistry) and, with titanium, the superconductor wire of IV and above.

quests.title: Indium
quests.subtitle: Zinc and lead, together
desc: Purified sphalerite and purified galena, with sulfuric acid in a mixer, give indium concentrate; an EV chemical reactor with aluminium turns the concentrate into indium dust. Galena only comes from the vents.
Indium makes indium gallium phosphide, and the IV circuits and wafers that use it.

quests.title: Item Magnets
quests.subtitle: 2010 called, it wants its juggalo meme back
desc: The &6Item Magnet&r is exactly what you'd expect — a magnet that pulls nearby &6items&r straight to you. &aVery useful&r. What more could you ask for?
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Tools
quests.subtitle: It's all a hammer anyways.
desc: The only thing separating man from animal is our use of &l&bTools&r&r. &7&oExcept for apes, monkeys, dolphins, crows, otters, octo.......&r&r Use your skills and tools to make the most of this world, and &5save yourself&r some effort.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Large and Small Vessels
quests.subtitle: Clay can be quite useful
desc:
&dSmall Vessels&r have 4 inventory slots while &6Large Vessels&r have 9! The &dSmall Vessel&r is not just for item storage: you can also melt ores and alloy basic metals in it.
The &6Large Vessel&r is a block, and once &3sealed&r it is great for preserving food.

&l&9Tip:&r&o Food in a Small Vessel or a sealed Large Vessel gets the Preserved trait and lasts longer, and it won't attract the rats that raid food left in chests.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Portable Storage Solutions
quests.subtitle: Turns out your inventory is quite small.
desc: In your travels, you may explore a whole &olot&r and end up picking up a lot of junk. This quest branch covers a couple of ways to carry and store more: TFC's &dvessels&r and Create's &dtoolboxes&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Smart Item Filter
quests.subtitle: Knock, knock - who's that? It's MENSA!
desc:
In this quest, we'll bestow upon you &5cursed wisdom&r... the ability to easily automate the Electrolyzer.

The &9Smart Item Filter&r is a filter that recognises Recipe Maps. When placed on the side of a machine, you can set it to "&3Electrolyzer&r" to allow insertion of electrolyzable items specifically. You heard that right - no need to filter manually!

Oh, and it only gets &abetter&r. If you combine this bad boy with a &aRobot Arm&r, it'll only supply the &6exact amount&r of items required for a successful recipe to the machine.
{@pagebreak}

Place the &aRobot Arm&r on your Electrolyzer, open its GUI, then place the &9Smart Filter&r inside. Ensure that the Smart Filter is set to Electrolyzer.

Next, configure it to &d&lImport&r and &d&lSupply Exact&r. Finally, attach any inventory &7(a chest will do)&r onto the side where you placed the &aRobot Arm&r. Ta-dah! You've figured out how to handle &6all&r Electrolyzer recipes!

What about the output of the &3Electrolyzer&r? You may want to route the Fluids to several Tanks - or even &3Super Tanks&r if you've gotten that far. We highly recommend that you avoid any methods involving voiding Fluids.&7.&7. except for Water for obvious reasons.
{@pagebreak}

&9Note:&r The Robot Arm has to facilitate the item transfer for its filtering functionality to work! Inserting directly into the machine &7(for instance, pushing with a Hopper!)&r will ignore the Robot Arm's &dSupply Exact&r setting.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: 250IQ
quests.subtitle: Stop burning your hands!
desc:
This is a guide on how to automatically route &lall&r your Hot Ingots to a cooler, while keeping everything automated in tip-top shape.

The &3Vacuum Freezer&r cools every hot ingot. The &3Chemical Bath&r only cools a few here: &ekanthal&r, &esilicon&r and the &eblack, red and blue steels&r. Everything else needs the freezer.

The cheap way would be to use filters, and manually add Hot Ingots one by one... which is so boring! Let's try the fun option.

Install an &aItem Tag Filter&r Cover on the side of your &3Vacuum Freezer&r's input bus, open it and set it to &e&l*hot_ingots*&r.

From here, you can route with &9any logistics system&r of your choice.
{@pagebreak}

Connect the output of your &3EBF(s)&r to the input of your cooler and to an output dump (Chest or Crate). You can also put a &dRestrictive Pipe&r in front of the output dump so the cooler gets priority.

&l&9Note:&r If you wish to know more tags for more automation setups, they will display if you press Shift when hovering over an item. For instance, an item tagged with &e&o#c:plates/copper&r is matched by &e&lc:plates/copper&r, or by a wildcard such as &e&l*plates/copper&r.

&9&lOther Note:&r The Item Tag Filter accepts whole expressions: AND, OR and NOT, wildcards and grouping. Hover over the info icon for the syntax.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: GregTech Storage
quests.subtitle: Earlygame buffering
desc:
In theory, Crates are flat upgrades to Chests. A single block space that stores more items - what more could you ask for?

They're more expensive than regular Chests, but they hold items of any size and can &6accept Covers&r, making them perfect candidates for buffers in automation.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Tape for Crates
quests.subtitle: Moving stuff around
desc:
You can right-click a Crate with Tape, which will then make the crate keep its contents when broken, making it easy to move around. This only works once per tape, however.

Good thing it's cheap!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Filters
desc:
With &5GregTech&r, you get access to various &6filters&r that help you ease into &aautomation&r. All of them are compatible with different &dCovers&r, which you'll learn more about during the &7LV&r Chapter.

Here, we're introducing two more specific filters that you might find &bhandy&r in certain situations.

To use a filter, simply apply it as a &dCover&r on any &5GT Machine&r or &6pipe&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Nano Saber
quests.subtitle: 26 Attack Damage when active!
desc: The &6Nano Saber&r is a powerful weapon you’ll be able to unlock once you reach late &5EV&r. Simply use &dShift + Right-Click&r to activate the &cbzzzzz mode&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Face Mask
desc: The &6Face Mask&r will protect you from &cinhaling dangerous dust&r. It's &aeasy to craft&r, just paper and string, and worth wearing whenever you handle a powder with an inhalation hazard.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: NanoMuscle™ Suite
quests.subtitle: Nanomachines, son!
desc:
A modern suit of armor for the modern era! Like GregTech's power tools, every piece runs on charge.

- The Helmet comes with built-in night vision goggles.

- The Chestplate doesn't do a lot on its own, but can be upgraded to have a jetpack.

- The Leggings round off the set.

- The Boots completely protect you from fall damage and have a toggleable Step Assist mode.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Power Tools
quests.subtitle: Men only want one thing and it's f&kuck&ring disgusting
desc:
As with any good tech mod, &5GregTech&r comes with a wide variety of &6tools&r you can use. To operate them, you'll need to &acharge them with energy&r — and there are several ways to do that: place the tool in a &6Battery Buffer&r, in an &denergy slot&r of a machine, or even better, use a &eTurbo Charger&r.

Just remember: you can only charge an item using a power source of &7equal&r or &ahigher tier&r. &cLower-tier sources&r won’t work on higher-tier tools — but don’t worry, &cnothing should explode&r. Probably.
{@pagebreak}

Most &5GregTech&r power tools are crafted from a material's &6Tool Head&r (a Drill Head, a Chainsaw Head...) and a &6Power Unit&r. Try using &aEMI&r to explore what you can do with them — just remember two important things:

- The &ePower Unit's tier&r (LV, MV, HV...) sets the tool's tier and the &6size of its battery&r.
- The &cmaterial&r of the head decides how good the tool itself is.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: GregTech Armor
desc:
With &5GregTech&r comes its own line of armor. Sure, it was cool to wear &7metal plates&r, but now that you're an &bindustrial maniac&r, maybe it's time to check out some &atechnological armor&r.

The first model, the &6NanoMuscle™ Suite&r, becomes available around &6HV&r. It runs on charge like the power tools and brings night vision, freedom from fall damage and, later, a &dJetpack&r upgrade.

The second model, &dQuarkTech™&r, won't be available until much later — around &1IV&r and &dLuV&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Hazardous Materials
quests.subtitle: Choking Hazard, Ages 3+
desc:
With the new version of &5Gregtech&r, a &chazard system&r has been introduced. By holding &dShift&r while hovering over &cHazardous Materials&r, you can see how they might affect you.

We strongly advise using proper &6protective equipment&r to keep your &corgans intact&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Rubber Gloves
desc: The &6Rubber Gloves&r will obviously protect you from &cskin contact hazards&r. Two &7Rubber Plates&r on the crafting grid is all they take.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Hazardous Materials Suit
quests.subtitle: Jesse! JESSE!
desc: The &6Hazardous Materials Suit&r is the best way to protect yourself from &cany kind of harm&r. You’ll be able to craft it once you reach &bMV&r, and &ayou should definitely take the time to do so&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Long-Distance Fluid Pipes
quests.subtitle: Wondering how to move that oil around?
desc:
&3Long-Distance Fluid Pipes&r can be used to send fluids across great distances. Place one endpoint at each end, and connect them with pipeline blocks.

These pipes instantly transfer from the input side to the output side.

They also have a minimum distance between pipe endpoints, so you can't use these for short-range operations.

These pipes have a reputation of being &4buggy&r to set up. If they don't seem to work at first, try rotating the endpoints with a &eWrench&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Long-Distance Item Pipes
quests.subtitle: Wondering how to move those ores around?
desc:
&3Long-Distance Item Pipes&r can be used to send items across great distances. Place one endpoint at each end, and connect them with pipeline blocks.

These pipes instantly transfer from the input side to the output side.

They also have a minimum distance between pipe endpoints, so you can't use these for short-range operations.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: GregTech
quests.subtitle: The industrial third of this pack.
desc: &3GregTech&r can be quite intimidating, this quest branch should help you out.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Duct Tape
quests.subtitle: If you can't fix it with this, use more of it!
desc:
You may have realized that most &eMultiblocks&r require a &6Maintenance Hatch&r. Until &6HV&r, where you can get an &aAutomatic Maintenance Hatch&r, you can use this item to fix the hatch without needing to use all of your maintenance tools.

It can be really useful if you don't want to invest in an &aAuto Maintenance Hatch&r yet, or if you're simply &cnot there yet&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Tricorder
quests.subtitle: For the nosiest GregTech players
desc:
The &aPortable Scanner&r, or &aTricorder&r, is GTCEu's debug tool.

Using it will show you a block's details, the details of the energy network, its current status and contents, and its impact on performance.

It'll also display a percentage of fluid remaining in the fluid vein for the &3Fluid Rigs&r.
{@pagebreak}
&l&3Lore:&r&o This little useful device comes from GregTech 5. It was extremely useful in the early days, because very little information (basically nothing) was given by GUIs or WAILA.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Machine Memory Card
quests.subtitle: Copy and Paste
desc:
When you try to &aparallelize your setup&r with more machines, it can be a bother to set all the &einputs&r and &eoutputs&r for each one. Yeah, we're thinking of you, &dSuper Chests&r and &dTanks&r.

If you ever find yourself needing this little tool, don't hesitate to use it.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Terminal
quests.subtitle: Automatic Multiblock Builder
desc:
&bThe Terminal&r has one main purpose, and &awe highly encourage you to craft it&r.

Building all these &eMultiblocks&r can be a bit &cintimidating&r, right? Well, here's a tip: use &dShift + Right-Click&r on any &6Multiblock Controller&r to &aautomatically assemble the entire structure&r!

You might need to &emove around some buses and hatches&r to suit your setup, but overall, this feature will save you a &alot of time&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Advanced NanoMuscle™ Chestplate
quests.subtitle: FREEEE BIIIIIIRD
desc:
The advanced chestplate is &oalmost&r as good as creative-mode flight.

It's amazing for whizzing around your base, with its only downside being that it drains its internal battery fairly quickly.

Keep a couple extra batteries on you, then they can charge up the suit by enabling Discharge mode on them with &aSneak-Right-Click&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Lamps
quests.subtitle: These are pretty.
desc:
Just like in regular Minecraft, &dLamps&r can be hung from the ceiling with the help of chains or placed on top of blocks. They're smithed on an anvil, finished with &dLamp Glass&r, and filled with a bucket of liquid fuel such as &6Olive Oil&r or &6Tallow&r.

Lava keeps burning &4indefinitely&r, but only a Blue Steel or Red Steel lamp can hold it. Lamps keep their fuel when broken.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Glass Blocks
quests.subtitle: Get yourself some windows.
desc:
&dGlass Blocks&r come from a &3Basin Pour&r and glass panes (TFC's &dPoured Glass&r) from a &3Table Pour&r. Depending on the type of sand used for the &aGlass Batch&r, your glass will have a different natural color; silica glass from white sand is clear.

Check out the &2Field Guide&r section on &3Glass Products&r to learn how powders added from a &aBowl&r make other colors. Later on, &3GregTech&r's Chemical Bath can dye glass blocks with liquid dye.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Glassblowing Tools
quests.subtitle: Tools of the Trade
desc:
To work &dGlass&r you'll need a variety of tools, held in your off-hand while you use the blowpipe.

&3Paddle&r: Performs flatten, mainly used for creating &dGlass Panes&r and &dLamp Glass.&r

&3Gem Saw&r: Performs saw, the last step of most glass products. It also breaks placed &dGlass Blocks&r and &dPanes&r so you get them back.

&3Jacks&r: Used to pinch glass, needed for &dLamp Glass&r and &dJars.&r

&3Wool Cloth&r: Used for rolling glass, needed for &dLenses&r and &dJars.&r
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Glassblowing
quests.subtitle: Realistic Glassworking!
desc:
To make any sort of &dGlass&r, you'll need a &3glassblowing&r setup.

It starts with a &aBlowpipe&r: knap one from clay and fire it into a &aCeramic Blowpipe&r (brittle, it can break), or work a sturdier one from a &6Brass Rod&r on an anvil. Add a &aGlass Batch&r, heat it to &4Faint Red&r, and work it.

&dGlass Panes&r and &dBlocks&r are poured onto &6Brass Plated Blocks&r: a flat table of them for panes, a basin for blocks. Check out the &2Field Guide&r for the details.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Fishing Rods
quests.subtitle: Patience is a virtue.
desc:
Fish have never been so easy to catch. Well, almost. Forge a &dFish Hook&r on an anvil and craft it into a &dFishing Rod&r with sticks and string.

A rod is useless without &abait&r, added on the crafting grid: &aseeds&r or &ashellfish&r for normal fish, and cod, salmon, tropical fish or bluegill for big catches like dolphins and orcas.

Cast, wait for a bite, then reel in without pulling too fast or the fish gets away with your bait. Pull it onto land and finish it with a tool.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Toolboxes
quests.subtitle: A builders dream
desc: The &dToolbox&r has 8 inventory slots which can each hold 4 stacks of items. Additionally, you can use a &ckeybind&r to access your placed &dToolbox&r from a few blocks away. You can even &bdye&r your &dToolbox&r to personalize it!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Lightning Rod
quests.subtitle: Undesirable voltage
desc:
Thunderstorms can set your thatch and timber alight. To keep lightning away from your base, you can use a &dLightning Rod&r for the cheap price of 3 copper rods.

The &dLightning Rod&r redirects lightning that would strike within &3128 blocks&r onto itself, as long as nothing is built above it.
Beware: It &oredirects&r lightning and doesn't nullify it, so a strike can still start fires right around it. Place it far away from any flammables.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Diving Gear
quests.subtitle: Swimsuit not included
desc:
Create's &6Copper Diving Helmet&r lets you breathe underwater for as long as the &6Copper Backtank&r on your back has air. Place the backtank and give it rotational power to fill it up.

&aCopper Diving Boots&r make you sink and walk along the bottom instead of swimming.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: TerraFirmaCraft
quests.subtitle: The ground this pack stands on.
desc: &3TerraFirmaCraft&r is the survival half of this pack. This branch covers some of its handier features, such as &dglassworking&r, &dlamps&r and &bfishing&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter tools_tips

quests.title: Iron Age
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Crossbow
quests.subtitle: It's like a manual gun
desc: Quite simply, it functions the same as the vanilla crossbow. Like the bow, it fires arrows, which deal &9Piercing&r damage, so don't waste them on Skeletons.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Black Steel Age
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: &7LV&r
desc: Not much new equipment is available at &7LV&r, but GregTech's &6power tools&r arrive here, and some of them make fine weapons too.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Bronze Age
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Stone Age
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Knives
quests.subtitle: Stabby stabby
desc:
Knives are most useful for crafting, but they can be a weapon in a pinch. They deal &9Piercing&r damage, which Zombies are weak to.

For more information on &cDamage Types&r consult the &3Field Guide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Metal Shield
quests.subtitle: Premium protection
desc: Now these are some real shields. Metal shields are forged on an anvil from a &7double sheet&r of the metal, and better metals last longer.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Metal Armor
quests.subtitle: Only the shiniest suit of armor
desc:
Metal armor requires a two-step forging process, but don't be scared off by its difficulty: smith an unfinished piece from a &7double sheet&r (a single sheet for boots), then weld a sheet onto it (a double sheet for chestplates).

All metal armor will give you bonus protection to &6Slashing&r, &9Piercing&r, and &2Crushing&r damage, and steel armor adds toughness on top.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Javelins
quests.subtitle: Caveman's bow
desc:
If you want to keep your foes away from you, javelins are the weapon for you. They are the earliest ranged weapons you will have available to you. They deal &9Piercing&r damage, which can help you against Zombies, but Skeletons shrug it off completely.

For more information on &cDamage Types&r consult the &3Field Guide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Forged Weapons
quests.subtitle: To wrought iron and beyond!
desc: Molds only take copper and the bronzes. From wrought iron on, you will need to forge your weapons: work the blade or head on an anvil of at least the metal's tier (a wrought iron anvil for wrought iron, a steel anvil for steel...), then finish it on the crafting grid.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Chainsaws
quests.subtitle: Hockey mask not included
desc: Chainsaws are a power tool you might craft for faster tree felling, but they also make for good melee weapons!
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Axes
quests.subtitle: Good for more than wood
desc:
Until you can upgrade, an axe will be your most reliable weapon. Along with high damage, they deal &6Slashing&r damage, which neither Zombies nor Skeletons resist.

For more information on &cDamage Types&r consult the &3Field Guide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Primitive Metallurgy
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Bow and Arrow
quests.subtitle: Then I took an arrow to the knee...
desc:
While javelins are cool, it's hard to beat a bow and arrow. Arrows can be expensive, so setting up a bird farm for feathers isn't a bad idea.

Arrows deal &9Piercing&r damage: good against Zombies, useless against Skeletons, which are immune to it.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Hammers
quests.subtitle: It's hammer time!
desc:
While combat may not be the first thing you think to do with your hammer, it can be surprisingly effective. Hammers deal &2Crushing&r damage which can help you against Skeletons. 

For more information on &cDamage Types&r consult the &3Field Guide&r.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Molded Weapons
quests.subtitle: The power of metal
desc:
Molds allow you to make copper and bronze versions of most weapons, including three new types: Swords, Scythes, and Maces.

Swords: These well rounded weapons deal &6Slashing&r damage.

Scythes: They also deal &6Slashing&r damage.

Maces: Heavy weapons that deal &2Crushing&r damage, a Skeleton's worst nightmare.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Wooden Shield
quests.subtitle: Skeletons hurt, like a lot
desc:
A wooden shield, made from lumber and glue, will protect you somewhat from most damage sources you point it at.

It's cheap, and it shows. Metal shields come once you can work an anvil.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Leather Armor
quests.subtitle: Clothes at last
desc:
Once you have leather, you will be able to get your first true armor. It isn't great, but it will provide that extra protection you may need. 

They also give you a slight resistance to &6Slashing&r damage.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: &6HV&r
desc: &6HV&r doesn't unlock any new weapons, but it does come with an important piece of equipment: GregTech's &6NanoMuscle™ Suite&r (see Tips: Tools).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Armor Trims
quests.subtitle: Add some flair to your fit
desc:
Almost everything you can wear can have an armor trim applied, TFC's metal armor included. Check the &a#minecraft:trimmable_armor&r tag to see what you can apply trims to, and the &a#minecraft:trim_materials&r tag for your color options: TFC's gems, silver, sterling silver, gold, rose gold and bismuth.

Smithing templates are sewn on a &6Sewing Table&r, then applied at a &6Smithing Table&r. Trims are purely cosmetic.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Red Steel Diving Gear
quests.subtitle: Almost lava-proof
desc:
In this pack, &4Red Steel&r takes Create's diving gear to its netherite tier: weld a Red Steel Helmet, Chestplate or Boots onto the matching copper piece to get the &4Netherite Diving Helmet&r, &4Backtank&r and &4Boots&r. They're much tougher than copper, and with air in the backtank the helmet lets you breathe even in &clava&r.

Create only makes you immune to burning when &oall four&r armor slots are fire-resistant, and the leggings would have to be netherite, which needs the Nether. So treat lava as deadly all the same.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter combat_tips

quests.title: Hydrogen
quests.subtitle: Element #1
desc:
Hydrogen is used in countless GregTech chemical reactions, starting in &7LV&r with hydrochloric acid.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r in infinite amounts by electrolyzing water, or salt water (the sea will do), which also gives chlorine.

Deuterium and tritium are for collectors: centrifuge hydrogen into deuterium (&7LV&r) and deuterium into tritium (&bMV&r).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Helium
quests.subtitle: Element #2
desc:
Helium is used in &6HV&r+ to speed up the electric blast furnace, and as liquid helium to cool hot ingots in the vacuum freezer.

It can be obtained from liquid air: freeze air from a gas collector in the vacuum freezer, then distill it in the distillation tower. Both multiblocks need &5EV&r circuits.

Helium-3 can be obtained by centrifuging helium (&bMV&r).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Lithium
quests.subtitle: Element #3
desc:
Lithium is the best electrolyte for &7LV&r, &bMV&r and &6HV&r batteries.

GregTech's ore veins are off here, so lithium comes from clay: electrolyze clay dust (macerated clay) in an &bMV&r electrolyzer for lithium, sodium, aluminium and silicon.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Beryllium
quests.subtitle: Element #4
desc:
Beryllium is used in &6HV&r to make ender pearl dust, together with potassium and nitrogen.

It is a byproduct of processing TFC emerald: macerating or washing crushed emerald ore gives beryllium dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Boron
quests.subtitle: Element #5
desc:
Boron goes into borosilicate glass and into magnesium diboride, the &bMV&r superconductor.

It can be obtained in &bMV&r by electrolyzing borax dust, which the macerator makes from TFC borax.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Carbon
quests.subtitle: Element #6
desc:
Carbon is the base of organic chemistry. It is used in &7LV&r+ to make resistors and later carbon fibres.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r by centrifuging coal dust (from TFC bituminous coal or lignite) or rubber logs, or by electrolyzing coke dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Nitrogen
quests.subtitle: Element #7
desc:
Nitrogen is used in &7LV&r+ for countless chemical reactions and to speed up the EBF and pyrolyse oven.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r in infinite amounts by centrifuging air from a gas collector.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Oxygen
quests.subtitle: Element #8
desc:
Oxygen is used in &7LV&r+ in countless chemical reactions, and in the electric blast furnace to roast sulfide ores.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r in infinite amounts by centrifuging air or electrolyzing water. Flint dust, centrifuged into silicon dioxide and electrolyzed, gives oxygen and silicon.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Fluorine
quests.subtitle: Element #9
desc:
Fluorine is used for hydrofluoric acid, and from it polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE).

It can be obtained in &bMV&r by electrolyzing topaz dust (from TFC topaz), or biotite dust, which the centrifuge separates from stone dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Sodium
quests.subtitle: Element #11
desc:
Sodium is a subpar &7LV&r to &6HV&r battery electrolyte, and with potassium it makes sodium-potassium, which &6HV&r+ energy hatches are made with.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r by electrolyzing salt dust, which comes from processing TFC halite ore.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Magnesium
quests.subtitle: Element #12
desc:
Magnesium is used in &6HV&r to make magnesium diboride, the &bMV&r superconductor, and to reduce titanium tetrachloride to titanium in the electric blast furnace. It also makes magnalium with aluminium.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r as a byproduct of TFC hematite (macerating refined hematite ore) and by electrolyzing magnesia, which centrifuging lava (&bMV&r) gives.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Aluminium
quests.subtitle: Element #13
desc:
Aluminium is the base material of &bMV&r: its machine casings are aluminium plates. Smelt the dust in the electric blast furnace (1700 K, &bMV&r power).

GregTech's ore veins are off here. Aluminium can be obtained in &7LV&r by electrolyzing sapphire dust (from TFC sapphire) and as a byproduct of processing TFC sapphire and emerald, and in &bMV&r by electrolyzing ruby or clay dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Silicon
quests.subtitle: Element #14
desc:
Silicon is used to make silicone rubber and, in the electric blast furnace with a pinch of gallium arsenide, the silicon boules that wafers and chips are cut from.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: centrifuge flint dust into silicon dioxide, then electrolyze it.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Phosphorus
quests.subtitle: Element #15
desc:
Phosphorus is a plant nutrient. It is used to make manganese phosphide, the &7LV&r superconductor, and later phosphorus-doped silicon boules.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r from tricalcium phosphate, a byproduct of processing TFC pyrite: centrifuge it into calcium and phosphate, then electrolyze the phosphate.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Sulfur
quests.subtitle: Element #16
desc:
Sulfur is used from the steam age on to vulcanize rubber, and in &7LV&r+ to make sulfuric acid.

It can be obtained from TFC sulfur and pyrite ores, and as a byproduct of cinnabar, gypsum and sphalerite: electrolyzing sphalerite dust gives zinc and sulfur.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Chlorine
quests.subtitle: Element #17
desc:
Chlorine is used in &7LV&r+ to make hydrochloric acid, and in many later chemical chains.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r in infinite amounts by electrolyzing salt water (the sea is salt water), or from salt and rock salt dust (TFC halite and sylvite).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Argon
quests.subtitle: Element #18
desc:
Argon is used to speed up the electric blast furnace for many high-tier alloys.

It can be obtained from liquid air in the distillation tower, like helium. The vacuum freezer and the distillation tower both need &5EV&r circuits.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Potassium
quests.subtitle: Element #19
desc:
Potassium is a plant nutrient. It is used in &6HV&r to make ender pearl dust, and with sodium it makes sodium-potassium, which &6HV&r+ energy hatches are made with.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r by electrolyzing rock salt dust (from TFC sylvite) and as a byproduct of processing TFC saltpeter.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Calcium
quests.subtitle: Element #20
desc:
Calcium is used in &6HV&r to make mercury barium calcium cuprate, the &6HV&r superconductor, and in GregTech's fertilizer recipes.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r in infinite amounts by electrolyzing bone meal, and as a byproduct of TFC gypsum and hematite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Titanium
quests.subtitle: Element #22
desc:
Titanium is the base material of &5EV&r: its machine casings are titanium plates.

GregTech's ore veins are off here. Centrifuge stone dust (left over from washing ores) into metal mixture, then centrifuge that in &5EV&r for ilmenite and bauxite. Ilmenite with carbon in the electric blast furnace, or electrolyzed bauxite, gives rutile; a chemical reactor turns rutile, carbon and chlorine into titanium tetrachloride, and the electric blast furnace reduces that with magnesium. Cool the hot ingot in the vacuum freezer.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Vanadium
quests.subtitle: Element #23
desc:
Vanadium is used to make vanadium steel, which the &bMV&r cutter's buzzsaw blade is made of, and vanadium-gallium.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: wash crushed TFC &aMagnetite&r in an &3Ore Washer&r (or centrifuge impure magnetite dust) for &aVanadium Magnetite&r, then &3Centrifuge&r that into magnetite and vanadium.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Chromium
quests.subtitle: Element #24
desc:
Chromium is used in &6HV&r+ to make stainless steel (the base material of &6HV&r) and in nichrome and kanthal for heating coils.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r as a byproduct of processing TFC ruby, or by electrolyzing ruby dust (&bMV&r). Smelt it in the electric blast furnace.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Manganese
quests.subtitle: Element #25
desc:
Manganese is used in &6HV&r+ to make stainless steel, and in manganese phosphide, the &7LV&r superconductor.

GregTech's ore veins are off here. Manganese can be obtained in &bMV&r by electrolyzing tantalite (centrifuged from lava) or spessartine (centrifuged from red garnet, a byproduct of TFC ruby).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Iron
quests.subtitle: Element #26
desc:
Iron is the metal of TFC's iron age, and steel is the base material of &7LV&r.

In this pack iron means TFC wrought iron: smelt TFC hematite, magnetite or limonite in a bloomery and work the bloom on an anvil. Iron melted or smelted anywhere else becomes cast iron, and steel comes only from pig iron (TFC blast furnace).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Cobalt
quests.subtitle: Element #27
desc:
Cobalt is used in &7LV&r to make cobalt brass (brass, aluminium and cobalt in the mixer), whose buzzsaw blade goes into the &7LV&r cutter, and later in various alloys.

It can be obtained as a byproduct of processing TFC native copper: macerating or washing crushed copper ore.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Nickel
quests.subtitle: Element #28
desc:
Nickel goes into TFC's black steel, and in GregTech into invar (the electric blast furnace's casings), cupronickel (its first coils), nichrome, stainless steel and many other alloys.

It can be obtained from TFC garnierite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Copper
quests.subtitle: Element #29
desc:
Copper is TFC's first metal. In GregTech, copper wires, fine wires and foil go into circuit boards and electronic components from &7LV&r on.

It can be obtained from TFC native copper, malachite and tetrahedrite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Zinc
quests.subtitle: Element #30
desc:
Zinc is used in the bronze age for brass (Create's brass, and with it airships) and bismuth bronze, and later in nickel-zinc ferrite for inductors.

It can be obtained from TFC sphalerite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Gallium
quests.subtitle: Element #31
desc:
Gallium is used to make gallium arsenide for silicon boules and diodes.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r as a byproduct of processing TFC sphalerite, or by electrolyzing sphalerite dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Arsenic
quests.subtitle: Element #33
desc:
Arsenic goes into gallium arsenide, and with it every diode and silicon boule.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aTetrahedrite&r carries &aRealgar&r, the &3Thermal Centrifuge&r's by-product of crushed tetrahedrite. &3Centrifuge&r realgar dust into arsenic and sulfur.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Yttrium
quests.subtitle: Element #39
desc:
Yttrium goes into yttrium barium cuprate and other superconductors.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aCassiterite&r gives &aMonazite&r as its &3Ore Washer&r by-product. An &3Electrolyzer&r splits monazite dust into rare earth and phosphate, and a &3Centrifuge&r separates rare earth into small piles of cadmium, neodymium, samarium, cerium, yttrium and lanthanum.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Molybdenum
quests.subtitle: Element #42
desc:
Molybdenum goes into RTM alloy, molybdenum disilicide coils and several high-tier alloys.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aMalachite&r gives &aMolybdenite&r as its &3Thermal Centrifuge&r by-product; an &3Electrolyzer&r splits it into molybdenum and sulfur.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Ruthenium
quests.subtitle: Element #44
desc:
Ruthenium is used in RTM alloy, for heating coils, and in ruridit.

It comes from GregTech's platinum line: a chemical reactor turns purified TFC tetrahedrite ore and nitric acid into platinum group sludge, and centrifuging the sludge with aqua regia (&6HV&r) gives inert metal mixture. A chemical reactor (&5EV&r) splits that with sulfuric acid into rhodium sulfate and ruthenium tetroxide, and ruthenium tetroxide with carbon gives ruthenium.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Rhodium
quests.subtitle: Element #45
desc:
Rhodium is used to make rhodium-plated palladium, the base material of &dLuV&r.

It comes from the platinum line (see ruthenium): electrolyze the rhodium sulfate split from inert metal mixture (&5EV&r).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Palladium
quests.subtitle: Element #46
desc:
Palladium is used to make rhodium-plated palladium, the base material of &dLuV&r.

It comes from GregTech's platinum line: a chemical reactor turns purified TFC tetrahedrite ore and nitric acid into platinum group sludge, and centrifuging the sludge with aqua regia (&6HV&r) gives raw palladium dust, which a chemical reactor turns into palladium with hydrochloric acid.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Silver
quests.subtitle: Element #47
desc:
Silver is used in the bronze age for TFC's sterling silver, and in GregTech for electrum and the silver cables of &6HV&r motors.

It can be obtained from TFC native silver.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Cadmium
quests.subtitle: Element #48
desc:
Cadmium is a subpar &7LV&r to &6HV&r battery electrolyte.

It can be obtained as a byproduct of washing crushed TFC tetrahedrite with sodium persulfate in the chemical bath, or of macerating refined sphalerite or tetrahedrite ore.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Tin
quests.subtitle: Element #50
desc:
Tin is used in the bronze age to make bronze, and in GregTech for soldering alloy and the tin cables of &7LV&r.

It can be obtained from TFC cassiterite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Antimony
quests.subtitle: Element #51
desc:
Antimony is used in &7LV&r to make battery alloy and soldering alloy.

It can be obtained as a byproduct of processing TFC tetrahedrite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Iodine
quests.subtitle: Element #53
desc:
Iodine has little use in GregTech (potassium iodide); it is here for the set.

It can be obtained in &6HV&r: a chemical reactor makes it from a dried kelp block, hydrogen and hydrogen peroxide. Craft the block from nine TFC dried kelp or dried seaweed (dry fresh seaweed by a fire).
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Barium
quests.subtitle: Element #56
desc:
Barium is used in &6HV&r to make mercury barium calcium cuprate, the &6HV&r superconductor.

GregTech's ore veins are off here. Centrifuge stone dust into metal mixture, centrifuge that in &5EV&r for barite, and electrolyze the barite.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Lanthanum
quests.subtitle: Element #57
desc:
Lanthanum goes into a few late alloys.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aCassiterite&r gives &aMonazite&r as its &3Ore Washer&r by-product. An &3Electrolyzer&r splits monazite dust into rare earth and phosphate, and a &3Centrifuge&r separates rare earth into small piles of cadmium, neodymium, samarium, cerium, yttrium and lanthanum.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Cerium
quests.subtitle: Element #58
desc:
Cerium has few uses in GregTech; it is here for the set.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aCassiterite&r gives &aMonazite&r as its &3Ore Washer&r by-product. An &3Electrolyzer&r splits monazite dust into rare earth and phosphate, and a &3Centrifuge&r separates rare earth into small piles of cadmium, neodymium, samarium, cerium, yttrium and lanthanum.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Neodymium
quests.subtitle: Element #60
desc:
Neodymium makes the magnetic rods of &5EV&r and &9IV&r electric motors.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aCassiterite&r gives &aMonazite&r as its &3Ore Washer&r by-product. An &3Electrolyzer&r splits monazite dust into rare earth and phosphate, and a &3Centrifuge&r separates rare earth into small piles of cadmium, neodymium, samarium, cerium, yttrium and lanthanum.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Samarium
quests.subtitle: Element #62
desc:
Samarium makes samarium-iron-arsenic oxide and magnetic samarium.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r: TFC &aCassiterite&r gives &aMonazite&r as its &3Ore Washer&r by-product. An &3Electrolyzer&r splits monazite dust into rare earth and phosphate, and a &3Centrifuge&r separates rare earth into small piles of cadmium, neodymium, samarium, cerium, yttrium and lanthanum.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Tantalum
quests.subtitle: Element #73
desc:
Tantalum is used to make tantalum capacitors and SMD resistors.

GregTech's ore veins are off here. Centrifuge lava (&bMV&r) for a little tantalite, then electrolyze the tantalite for tantalum and manganese.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Tungsten
quests.subtitle: Element #74
desc:
Tungsten makes tungstensteel, the material of &9IV&r machines, and tungsten carbide.

It can be obtained in &5EV&r: TFC &aCassiterite&r gives &aScheelite&r as its &3Thermal Centrifuge&r by-product. An &5EV&r &3Chemical Bath&r turns scheelite and hydrochloric acid into tungstic acid, and an &5EV&r &3Electrolyzer&r splits that into tungsten.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Osmium
quests.subtitle: Element #76
desc: Osmium comes at the end of the platinum line: TFC &aTetrahedrite&r's purified ore gives &aPlatinum Group Sludge&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r, and its later separation steps (follow EMI from the sludge) leave osmium.

quests.title: Iridium
quests.subtitle: Element #77
desc: Iridium comes at the end of the platinum line: TFC &aTetrahedrite&r's purified ore gives &aPlatinum Group Sludge&r in a &3Chemical Reactor&r, and its later separation steps (follow EMI from the sludge) leave iridium.

quests.title: Platinum
quests.subtitle: Element #78
desc:
Platinum is a high-tier GregTech metal: platinum cables and uranium triplatinum, the &5EV&r superconductor.

It comes from GregTech's platinum line: a chemical reactor turns purified TFC tetrahedrite ore and nitric acid into platinum group sludge, and centrifuging the sludge with aqua regia (&6HV&r) gives raw platinum dust, which an electrolyzer splits into platinum.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Gold
quests.subtitle: Element #79
desc:
Gold is used in the bronze age for TFC's rose gold, and in GregTech for electrum and the gold cables of &6HV&r.

It can be obtained from TFC native gold.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Mercury
quests.subtitle: Element #80
desc:
Mercury is used in &7LV&r+ in the chemical bath to wash ores for extra byproducts, and in the &6HV&r superconductor.

It can be obtained in &7LV&r by centrifuging cinnabar dust (from TFC cinnabar) or redstone.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Lead
quests.subtitle: Element #82
desc:
Lead is used in &7LV&r+ to make soldering alloy and battery alloy.

GregTech's ore veins are off here, so lead is a byproduct of TFC native silver: macerating or washing crushed silver ore gives lead dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Bismuth
quests.subtitle: Element #83
desc:
Bismuth is used in the bronze age to make bismuth bronze.

It can be obtained from TFC bismuthinite; GregTech's macerator grinds it straight into bismuth dust.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements

quests.title: Thorium
quests.subtitle: Element #90
desc:
Thorium has little use in GregTech; it is here for the set.

GregTech's ore veins are off here, but macerating deepslate has a small chance to give thorium dust. TFC worlds have no deepslate: compact four TFC loose slate rocks into deepslate with a mechanical press over a basin.
quests.source: Ported from TerraFirmaGreg (LGPL-3.0), commit b43cb47849, chapter chemical_elements
